}

func NewServer(db *pgxpool.Pool) *Server {
	return &Server{
		db:      db,
		wsConns: make(map[*websocket.Conn]bool),
		upgrader: websocket.Upgrader{
			CheckOrigin: func(r *http.Request) bool { return true },
		},
	}
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}

func writeData(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]any{"data": data})
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string, msg string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{
		"error": msg,
		"code":  code,
	})
}

func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, dst any, allowEmpty bool) ([]byte, error) {
	bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(bodyBytes)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 {
		if allowEmpty {
			return []byte("{}"), nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty body")
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := dec.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trailing data")
	}
	return trimmed, nil
}

func parseTimeISO(s string) (time.Time, error) {
	if s == "" {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("empty time")
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid time: %s", s)
}

func formatTimeISO(t time.Time) string {
	return t.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
}

func haversineKm(c1, c2 Coordinate) float64 {
	const R = 6371.0
	lat1 := c1.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	lat2 := c2.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLat := (c2.Latitude - c1.Latitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLon := (c2.Longitude - c1.Longitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	a := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) +
		math.Cos(lat1)*math.Cos(lat2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)
	c := 2 * math.Atan2(math.Sqrt(a), math.Sqrt(1-a))
	return R * c
}

func validateCoordinate(c Coordinate) bool {
	if math.IsNaN(c.Latitude) || math.IsNaN(c.Longitude) {
		return false
	}
	return c.Latitude >= -90 && c.Latitude <= 90 && c.Longitude >= -180 && c.Longitude <= 180
}

func isValidRole(r string) bool {
	switch r {
	case "administrator", "dispatcher", "requester", "collection_professional", "delivery_partner", "node_handler", "laboratory_team":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func hasString(slice []string, val string) bool {
	for _, s := range slice {
		if s == val {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isLocationStale(recordedAt *time.Time, refTime time.Time) bool {
	if recordedAt == nil {
		return true
	}
	if refTime.IsZero() {
		refTime = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	diff := refTime.Sub(*recordedAt)
	return diff > 15*time.Minute
}

func (s *Server) recordAudit(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID string, success bool, occurredAt time.Time, details map[string]any) {
	if occurredAt.IsZero() {
		occurredAt = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	if details == nil {
		details = map[string]any{}
	}
	if actorID == "" {
		actorID = "anonymous"
	}
	if role == "" {
		role = "none"
	}
	detailsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(details)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO audit_logs (audit_id, actor_id, role, action, entity_type, entity_id, success, occurred_at, details)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
	`, uuid.New(), actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID, success, occurredAt, detailsBytes)
}

func (s *Server) publishEvent(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, evType, entityType, entityID string, payload map[string]any) {
	if payload == nil {
		payload = map[string]any{}
	}
	payloadBytes, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	var id int64
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO realtime_events (type, entity_type, entity_id, payload, created_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
		RETURNING id
	`, evType, entityType, entityID, payloadBytes, now).Scan(&id)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	ev := RealtimeEvent{
		ID:         id,
		Type:       evType,
		EntityType: entityType,
		EntityID:   entityID,
		Payload:    payload,
		CreatedAt:  formatTimeISO(now),
	}
	s.broadcastWS(ev)
}

func (s *Server) broadcastWS(ev RealtimeEvent) {
	s.wsMu.Lock()
	defer s.wsMu.Unlock()
	msg, err := json.Marshal(ev)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	for conn := range s.wsConns {
		_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg); err != nil {
			_ = conn.Close()
			delete(s.wsConns, conn)
		}
	}
}

func hashRequestPayload(raw []byte) string {
	var canonical any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical); err == nil {
		if b, err := json.Marshal(canonical); err == nil {
			raw = b
		}
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (s *Server) checkIdempotency(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, key, operation string, rawReq []byte) (found bool, conflict bool, status int, respBody []byte) {
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	var storedHash string
	var storedStatus int
	var storedResp []byte
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT req_hash, status_code, response_body
		FROM idempotency_keys
		WHERE key = $1 AND operation = $2
	`, key, operation).Scan(&storedHash, &storedStatus, &storedResp)
	if err != nil {
		return false, false, 0, nil
	}
	if storedHash != reqHash {
		return true, true, 409, nil
	}
	return true, false, storedStatus, storedResp
}

func (s *Server) saveIdempotency(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, key, operation, actorID string, rawReq []byte, status int, dataPayload any) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	envelope := map[string]any{"data": dataPayload}
	respBytes, _ := json.Marshal(envelope)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, operation, actor_id, req_hash, status_code, response_body)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
		ON CONFLICT (key, operation) DO NOTHING
	`, key, operation, actorID, reqHash, status, respBytes)
}

func (s *Server) authenticateRequest(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request) (*AuthContext, error) {
	token := ""
	authHeader := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(authHeader), "bearer ") {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(authHeader[7:])
	}
	if token == "" {
		wsProto := r.Header.Get("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol")
		for _, part := range strings.Split(wsProto, ",") {
			p := strings.TrimSpace(part)
			if strings.HasPrefix(p, "bearer.") {
				token = strings.TrimPrefix(p, "bearer.")
				break
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(p), "bearer ") {
				token = strings.TrimSpace(p[7:])
				break
			} else if p != "" && p != "json" && p != "realtime" && len(p) > 16 {
				token = p
			}
		}
	}
	if token == "" {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("token"))
	}
	if token == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing token")
	}

	var userID uuid.UUID
	var username, fullName, activeRole string
	var roleSelected, active, available bool
	var rolesBytes, qualsBytes, certsBytes []byte
	var assignedLocID *uuid.UUID
	var capUnits int

	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.full_name, u.roles, u.qualifications, u.certifications,
		       u.active, u.assigned_location_id, u.available, u.capacity_units,
		       s.active_role, s.role_selected
		FROM sessions s
		JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
		WHERE s.token = $1
	`, token).Scan(
		&userID, &username, &fullName, &rolesBytes, &qualsBytes, &certsBytes,
		&active, &assignedLocID, &available, &capUnits,
		&activeRole, &roleSelected,
	)
	if err != nil || !active {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session")
	}

	var roles []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rolesBytes, &roles)
	var quals []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(qualsBytes, &quals)
	var certs []Certification
	_ = json.Unmarshal(certsBytes, &certs)

	if len(roles) == 1 && !roleSelected {
		activeRole = roles[0]
		roleSelected = true
	}
	if activeRole != "" && !hasString(roles, activeRole) {
		if len(roles) == 1 {
			activeRole = roles[0]
			roleSelected = true
		} else {
			activeRole = ""
			roleSelected = false
		}
	}

	return &AuthContext{
		UserID:             userID,
		Username:           username,
		FullName:           fullName,
		Roles:              roles,
		ActiveRole:         activeRole,
		RoleSelected:       roleSelected,
		Active:             active,
		AssignedLocationID: assignedLocID,
		Qualifications:     quals,
		Certifications:     certs,
		Available:          available,
		CapacityUnits:      capUnits,
		SessionToken:       token,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Server) requireRole(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, actionName string, allowedRoles ...string) (*AuthContext, bool) {
	auth, err := s.authenticateRequest(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, "anonymous", "none", actionName, "auth", "unauthorized", false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "unauthorized"})
		writeError(w, 401, "unauthorized", "Authentication required")
		return nil, false
	}
	if !auth.RoleSelected || auth.ActiveRole == "" {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), "unselected", actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "role_not_selected"})
		writeError(w, 409, "role_not_selected", "Active role must be selected first")
		return nil, false
	}
	if len(allowedRoles) > 0 && !hasString(allowedRoles, auth.ActiveRole) {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), auth.ActiveRole, actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "forbidden", "requiredRoles": allowedRoles})
		writeError(w, 403, "forbidden", "Active role is not permitted to perform this action")
		return nil, false
	}
	return auth, true
}

func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, dst any, allowEmpty bool) ([]byte, error) {
	bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(bodyBytes)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 {
		if allowEmpty {
			return []byte("{}"), nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty body")
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := dec.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trailing data")
	}
	return trimmed, nil
}

func parseTimeISO(s string) (time.Time, error) {

	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, s); err == nil {

func haversineKm(c1, c2 Coordinate) float64 {
	const R = 6371.0
	lat1 := c1.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	lat2 := c2.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLat := (c2.Latitude - c1.Latitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLon := (c2.Longitude - c1.Longitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	a := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) +
		math.Cos(lat1)*math.Cos(lat2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)
	c := 2 * math.Atan2(math.Sqrt(a), math.Sqrt(1-a))
	return R * c
}

func validateCoordinate(c Coordinate) bool {
	if math.IsNaN(c.Latitude) || math.IsNaN(c.Longitude) {
		return false
	}
	return c.Latitude >= -90 && c.Latitude <= 90 && c.Longitude >= -180 && c.Longitude <= 180
}

func isValidRole(r string) bool {
	switch r {
	case "administrator", "dispatcher", "requester", "collection_professional", "delivery_partner", "node_handler", "laboratory_team":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func hasString(slice []string, val string) bool {
	for _, s := range slice {
		if s == val {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isLocationStale(recordedAt *time.Time, refTime time.Time) bool {
	if recordedAt == nil {
		return true
	}
	if refTime.IsZero() {
		refTime = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	diff := refTime.Sub(*recordedAt)
	return diff > 15*time.Minute
}

func (s *Server) recordAudit(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID string, success bool, occurredAt time.Time, details map[string]any) {
	if occurredAt.IsZero() {
		occurredAt = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	if details == nil {
		details = map[string]any{}
	}
	if actorID == "" {
		actorID = "anonymous"
	}
	if role == "" {
		role = "none"
	}
	detailsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(details)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO audit_logs (audit_id, actor_id, role, action, entity_type, entity_id, success, occurred_at, details)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
	`, uuid.New(), actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID, success, occurredAt, detailsBytes)
}

func (s *Server) publishEvent(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, evType, entityType, entityID string, payload map[string]any) {
	if payload == nil {
		payload = map[string]any{}
	}
	payloadBytes, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	var id int64
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO realtime_events (type, entity_type, entity_id, payload, created_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
		RETURNING id
	`, evType, entityType, entityID, payloadBytes, now).Scan(&id)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	ev := RealtimeEvent{
		ID:         id,
		Type:       evType,
		EntityType: entityType,
		EntityID:   entityID,
		Payload:    payload,
		CreatedAt:  formatTimeISO(now),
	}
	s.broadcastWS(ev)
}

func (s *Server) broadcastWS(ev RealtimeEvent) {
	s.wsMu.Lock()
	defer s.wsMu.Unlock()
	msg, err := json.Marshal(ev)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	for conn := range s.wsConns {
		_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg); err != nil {
			_ = conn.Close()
			delete(s.wsConns, conn)
		}
	}
}

func hashRequestPayload(raw []byte) string {
	var canonical any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical); err == nil {
		if b, err := json.Marshal(canonical); err == nil {
			raw = b
		}
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (s *Server) checkIdempotency(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, key, operation string, rawReq []byte) (found bool, conflict bool, status int, respBody []byte) {
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	var storedHash string
	var storedStatus int
	var storedResp []byte
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT req_hash, status_code, response_body
		FROM idempotency_keys
		WHERE key = $1 AND operation = $2
	`, key, operation).Scan(&storedHash, &storedStatus, &storedResp)
	if err != nil {
		return false, false, 0, nil
	}
	if storedHash != reqHash {
		return true, true, 409, nil
	}
	return true, false, storedStatus, storedResp
}

func (s *Server) saveIdempotency(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, key, operation, actorID string, rawReq []byte, status int, dataPayload any) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	envelope := map[string]any{"data": dataPayload}
	respBytes, _ := json.Marshal(envelope)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, operation, actor_id, req_hash, status_code, response_body)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
		ON CONFLICT (key, operation) DO NOTHING
	`, key, operation, actorID, reqHash, status, respBytes)
}

func (s *Server) authenticateRequest(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request) (*AuthContext, error) {
	token := ""
	authHeader := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(authHeader), "bearer ") {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(authHeader[7:])
	}
	if token == "" {
		wsProto := r.Header.Get("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol")
		for _, part := range strings.Split(wsProto, ",") {
			p := strings.TrimSpace(part)
			if strings.HasPrefix(p, "bearer.") {
				token = strings.TrimPrefix(p, "bearer.")
				break
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(p), "bearer ") {
				token = strings.TrimSpace(p[7:])
				break
			} else if p != "" && p != "json" && p != "realtime" && len(p) > 16 {
				token = p
			}
		}
	}
	if token == "" {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("token"))
	}
	if token == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing token")
	}

	var userID uuid.UUID
	var username, fullName, activeRole string
	var roleSelected, active, available bool
	var rolesBytes, qualsBytes, certsBytes []byte
	var assignedLocID *uuid.UUID
	var capUnits int

	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.full_name, u.roles, u.qualifications, u.certifications,
		       u.active, u.assigned_location_id, u.available, u.capacity_units,
		       s.active_role, s.role_selected
		FROM sessions s
		JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
		WHERE s.token = $1
	`, token).Scan(
		&userID, &username, &fullName, &rolesBytes, &qualsBytes, &certsBytes,
		&active, &assignedLocID, &available, &capUnits,
		&activeRole, &roleSelected,
	)
	if err != nil || !active {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session")
	}

	var roles []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rolesBytes, &roles)
	var quals []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(qualsBytes, &quals)
	var certs []Certification
	_ = json.Unmarshal(certsBytes, &certs)

	if len(roles) == 1 && !roleSelected {
		activeRole = roles[0]
		roleSelected = true
	}
	if activeRole != "" && !hasString(roles, activeRole) {
		if len(roles) == 1 {
			activeRole = roles[0]
			roleSelected = true
		} else {
			activeRole = ""
			roleSelected = false
		}
	}

	return &AuthContext{
		UserID:             userID,
		Username:           username,
		FullName:           fullName,
		Roles:              roles,
		ActiveRole:         activeRole,
		RoleSelected:       roleSelected,
		Active:             active,
		AssignedLocationID: assignedLocID,
		Qualifications:     quals,
		Certifications:     certs,
		Available:          available,
		CapacityUnits:      capUnits,
		SessionToken:       token,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Server) requireRole(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, actionName string, allowedRoles ...string) (*AuthContext, bool) {
	auth, err := s.authenticateRequest(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, "anonymous", "none", actionName, "auth", "unauthorized", false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "unauthorized"})
		writeError(w, 401, "unauthorized", "Authentication required")
		return nil, false
	}
	if !auth.RoleSelected || auth.ActiveRole == "" {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), "unselected", actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "role_not_selected"})
		writeError(w, 409, "role_not_selected", "Active role must be selected first")
		return nil, false
	}
	if len(allowedRoles) > 0 && !hasString(allowedRoles, auth.ActiveRole) {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), auth.ActiveRole, actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "forbidden", "requiredRoles": allowedRoles})
		writeError(w, 403, "forbidden", "Active role is not permitted to perform this action")
		return nil, false
	}
	return auth, true
}

func hashPassword(password string) string {
        mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte("labsample-secret-salt-v1"))
        mac.Write([]byte(password))
        return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

func connectDB(ctx context.Context) (*pgxpool.Pool, error) {
        dbURL := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
        if dbURL == "" {
                dbURL = "postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena?sslmode=disable"
        }
        cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dbURL)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }
        cfg.MaxConns = 25
        return pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
}

func resetDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
        if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, dropAllSQL); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("drop tables: %w", err)
        }
        if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
        }
        if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
        }
        if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
}

func initDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
        if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
        }
        if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
        }
        if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
        }
        if err := ensureInitialAdmin(ctx, pool); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("ensure initial admin: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
}

func seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
        type defaultST struct {
                ID           uuid.UUID
                Name         string
                Qual         string
                Container    string
                TempMin      float64
                TempMax      float64
                Incompatible []string
                Cooled       bool
                Batching     bool
        }
        defaults := []defaultST{
                {
                        ID:           amberTypeID,
                        Name:         "Amber",
                        Qual:         "Amber",
                        Container:    "standard-vial",
                        TempMin:      15,
                        TempMax:      25,
                        Incompatible: []string{indigoTypeID.String()},
                        Cooled:       false,
                        Batching:     true,
                },
                {
                        ID:           indigoTypeID,
                        Name:         "Indigo",
                        Qual:         "Indigo",
                        Container:    "indigo-tube",
                        TempMin:      15,
                        TempMax:      25,
                        Incompatible: []string{amberTypeID.String()},
                        Cooled:       false,
                        Batching:     true,
                },
                {
                        ID:           frostTypeID,
                        Name:         "Frost",
                        Qual:         "Frost",
                        Container:    "cryo-vial",
                        TempMin:      2,
                        TempMax:      8,
                        Incompatible: []string{},
                        Cooled:       true,
                        Batching:     true,
                },
                {
                        ID:           pulseTypeID,
                        Name:         "Pulse",
                        Qual:         "Pulse",
                        Container:    "stat-carrier",
                        TempMin:      15,
                        TempMax:      25,
                        Incompatible: []string{},
                        Cooled:       false,
                        Batching:     false,
                },
        }

        for _, d := range defaults {
                incJSON, _ := json.Marshal(d.Incompatible)
                _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
                        INSERT INTO sample_types (
                                sample_type_id, name, qualified_collector_required, required_qualification,
                                container_type, temperature_min_c, temperature_max_c,
                                incompatible_sample_types, requires_cooled_route, batching_allowed
                        ) VALUES ($1, $2, TRUE, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
                        ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
                `, d.ID, d.Name, d.Qual, d.Container, d.TempMin, d.TempMax, incJSON, d.Cooled, d.Batching)
                if err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }
        return nil
}

func ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
        var count int
        if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serviceability_snapshots`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
                return err
        }
        if count == 0 {
                _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
                        INSERT INTO serviceability_snapshots (status, computed_at, network_revision, regions, active_collection_point_count)
                        VALUES ('complete', $1, 0, '[]'::jsonb, 0)
                `, time.Now().UTC())
                return err
        }
        return nil
}

func ensureInitialAdmin(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
        var count int
        if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
                return err
        }
        if count > 0 {
                return nil
        }
        username := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
        password := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
        if username == "" {
                username = "admin"
        }
        if password == "" {
                password = "admin"
        }
        adminID := uuid.New()
        rolesJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{"administrator"})
        qualsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{})
        certsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]any{})
        _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
                INSERT INTO users (
                        user_id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone,
                        roles, qualifications, certifications, active, available, capacity_units
                ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, '', $6, $7, $8, TRUE, TRUE, 10)
        `, adminID, username, hashPassword(password), username+"@labsample.local", "System Administrator", rolesJSON, qualsJSON, certsJSON)
        return err
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}

func writeData(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]any{"data": data})
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string, msg string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{
		"error": msg,
		"code":  code,
	})
}

func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, dst any, allowEmpty bool) ([]byte, error) {
	bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(bodyBytes)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 {
		if allowEmpty {
			return []byte("{}"), nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty body")
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := dec.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trailing data")
	}
	return trimmed, nil
}

func parseTimeISO(s string) (time.Time, error) {
	if s == "" {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("empty time")
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid time: %s", s)
}

func formatTimeISO(t time.Time) string {
	return t.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
}

func haversineKm(c1, c2 Coordinate) float64 {
	const R = 6371.0
	lat1 := c1.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	lat2 := c2.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLat := (c2.Latitude - c1.Latitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLon := (c2.Longitude - c1.Longitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	a := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) +
		math.Cos(lat1)*math.Cos(lat2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)
	c := 2 * math.Atan2(math.Sqrt(a), math.Sqrt(1-a))
	return R * c
}

func validateCoordinate(c Coordinate) bool {
	if math.IsNaN(c.Latitude) || math.IsNaN(c.Longitude) {
		return false
	}
	return c.Latitude >= -90 && c.Latitude <= 90 && c.Longitude >= -180 && c.Longitude <= 180
}

	return false
}

func hasString(slice []string, val string) bool {

	return false

func isLocationStale(recordedAt *time.Time, refTime time.Time) bool {
	if recordedAt == nil {
		return true
	}
	if refTime.IsZero() {
		refTime = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	diff := refTime.Sub(*recordedAt)
	return diff > 15*time.Minute
}

func (s *Server) recordAudit(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID string, success bool, occurredAt time.Time, details map[string]any) {
	if occurredAt.IsZero() {
		occurredAt = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	if details == nil {
		details = map[string]any{}
	}
	if actorID == "" {
		actorID = "anonymous"
	}
	if role == "" {
		role = "none"
	}
	detailsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(details)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO audit_logs (audit_id, actor_id, role, action, entity_type, entity_id, success, occurred_at, details)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
	`, uuid.New(), actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID, success, occurredAt, detailsBytes)
}

func (s *Server) publishEvent(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, evType, entityType, entityID string, payload map[string]any) {
	if payload == nil {
		payload = map[string]any{}
	}
	payloadBytes, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	var id int64
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO realtime_events (type, entity_type, entity_id, payload, created_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
		RETURNING id
	`, evType, entityType, entityID, payloadBytes, now).Scan(&id)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	ev := RealtimeEvent{
		ID:         id,
		Type:       evType,
		EntityType: entityType,
		EntityID:   entityID,
		Payload:    payload,
		CreatedAt:  formatTimeISO(now),
	}
	s.broadcastWS(ev)
}

func (s *Server) broadcastWS(ev RealtimeEvent) {
	s.wsMu.Lock()
	defer s.wsMu.Unlock()
	msg, err := json.Marshal(ev)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	for conn := range s.wsConns {
		_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg); err != nil {
			_ = conn.Close()
			delete(s.wsConns, conn)
		}
	}
}

func hashRequestPayload(raw []byte) string {
	var canonical any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical); err == nil {
		if b, err := json.Marshal(canonical); err == nil {
			raw = b
		}
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (s *Server) checkIdempotency(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, key, operation string, rawReq []byte) (found bool, conflict bool, status int, respBody []byte) {
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	var storedHash string
	var storedStatus int
	var storedResp []byte
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT req_hash, status_code, response_body
		FROM idempotency_keys
		WHERE key = $1 AND operation = $2
	`, key, operation).Scan(&storedHash, &storedStatus, &storedResp)
	if err != nil {
		return false, false, 0, nil
	}
	if storedHash != reqHash {
		return true, true, 409, nil
	}
	return true, false, storedStatus, storedResp
}

func (s *Server) saveIdempotency(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, key, operation, actorID string, rawReq []byte, status int, dataPayload any) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	envelope := map[string]any{"data": dataPayload}
	respBytes, _ := json.Marshal(envelope)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, operation, actor_id, req_hash, status_code, response_body)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
		ON CONFLICT (key, operation) DO NOTHING
	`, key, operation, actorID, reqHash, status, respBytes)
}

func (s *Server) authenticateRequest(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request) (*AuthContext, error) {
	token := ""
	authHeader := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(authHeader), "bearer ") {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(authHeader[7:])
	}
	if token == "" {
		wsProto := r.Header.Get("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol")
		for _, part := range strings.Split(wsProto, ",") {
			p := strings.TrimSpace(part)
			if strings.HasPrefix(p, "bearer.") {
				token = strings.TrimPrefix(p, "bearer.")
				break
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(p), "bearer ") {
				token = strings.TrimSpace(p[7:])
				break
			} else if p != "" && p != "json" && p != "realtime" && len(p) > 16 {
				token = p
			}
		}
	}
	if token == "" {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("token"))
	}
	if token == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing token")
	}

	var userID uuid.UUID
	var username, fullName, activeRole string
	var roleSelected, active, available bool
	var rolesBytes, qualsBytes, certsBytes []byte
	var assignedLocID *uuid.UUID
	var capUnits int

	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.full_name, u.roles, u.qualifications, u.certifications,
		       u.active, u.assigned_location_id, u.available, u.capacity_units,
		       s.active_role, s.role_selected
		FROM sessions s
		JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
		WHERE s.token = $1
	`, token).Scan(
		&userID, &username, &fullName, &rolesBytes, &qualsBytes, &certsBytes,
		&active, &assignedLocID, &available, &capUnits,
		&activeRole, &roleSelected,
	)
	if err != nil || !active {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session")
	}

	var roles []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rolesBytes, &roles)
	var quals []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(qualsBytes, &quals)
	var certs []Certification
	_ = json.Unmarshal(certsBytes, &certs)

	if len(roles) == 1 && !roleSelected {
		activeRole = roles[0]
		roleSelected = true
	}
	if activeRole != "" && !hasString(roles, activeRole) {
		if len(roles) == 1 {
			activeRole = roles[0]
			roleSelected = true
		} else {
			activeRole = ""
			roleSelected = false
		}
	}

	return &AuthContext{
		UserID:             userID,
		Username:           username,
		FullName:           fullName,
		Roles:              roles,
		ActiveRole:         activeRole,
		RoleSelected:       roleSelected,
		Active:             active,
		AssignedLocationID: assignedLocID,
		Qualifications:     quals,
		Certifications:     certs,
		Available:          available,
		CapacityUnits:      capUnits,
		SessionToken:       token,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Server) requireRole(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, actionName string, allowedRoles ...string) (*AuthContext, bool) {
	auth, err := s.authenticateRequest(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, "anonymous", "none", actionName, "auth", "unauthorized", false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "unauthorized"})
		writeError(w, 401, "unauthorized", "Authentication required")
		return nil, false
	}
	if !auth.RoleSelected || auth.ActiveRole == "" {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), "unselected", actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "role_not_selected"})
		writeError(w, 409, "role_not_selected", "Active role must be selected first")
		return nil, false
	}
	if len(allowedRoles) > 0 && !hasString(allowedRoles, auth.ActiveRole) {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), auth.ActiveRole, actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "forbidden", "requiredRoles": allowedRoles})
		writeError(w, 403, "forbidden", "Active role is not permitted to perform this action")
		return nil, false
	}
	return auth, true
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}

func writeData(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]any{"data": data})
}

	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{
		"error": msg,
		"code":  code,
	})
}

func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, dst any, allowEmpty bool) ([]byte, error) {
	bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(bodyBytes)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 {
		if allowEmpty {
			return []byte("{}"), nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty body")
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := dec.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trailing data")
	}
	return trimmed, nil
}

func parseTimeISO(s string) (time.Time, error) {
	if s == "" {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("empty time")
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid time: %s", s)
}

func formatTimeISO(t time.Time) string {
	return t.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
}

func haversineKm(c1, c2 Coordinate) float64 {
	const R = 6371.0
	lat1 := c1.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	lat2 := c2.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLat := (c2.Latitude - c1.Latitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLon := (c2.Longitude - c1.Longitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	a := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) +
		math.Cos(lat1)*math.Cos(lat2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)
	c := 2 * math.Atan2(math.Sqrt(a), math.Sqrt(1-a))
	return R * c
}

func validateCoordinate(c Coordinate) bool {
	if math.IsNaN(c.Latitude) || math.IsNaN(c.Longitude) {
		return false
	}
	return c.Latitude >= -90 && c.Latitude <= 90 && c.Longitude >= -180 && c.Longitude <= 180
}

func isValidRole(r string) bool {
	switch r {
	case "administrator", "dispatcher", "requester", "collection_professional", "delivery_partner", "node_handler", "laboratory_team":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func hasString(slice []string, val string) bool {
	for _, s := range slice {
		if s == val {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isLocationStale(recordedAt *time.Time, refTime time.Time) bool {
	if recordedAt == nil {
		return true
	}
	if refTime.IsZero() {
		refTime = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	diff := refTime.Sub(*recordedAt)
	return diff > 15*time.Minute
}

func (s *Server) recordAudit(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID string, success bool, occurredAt time.Time, details map[string]any) {
	if occurredAt.IsZero() {
		occurredAt = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	if details == nil {
		details = map[string]any{}
	}
	if actorID == "" {
		actorID = "anonymous"
	}
	if role == "" {
		role = "none"
	}
	detailsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(details)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO audit_logs (audit_id, actor_id, role, action, entity_type, entity_id, success, occurred_at, details)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
	`, uuid.New(), actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID, success, occurredAt, detailsBytes)
}

func (s *Server) publishEvent(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, evType, entityType, entityID string, payload map[string]any) {
	if payload == nil {
		payload = map[string]any{}
	}
	payloadBytes, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	var id int64
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO realtime_events (type, entity_type, entity_id, payload, created_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
		RETURNING id
	`, evType, entityType, entityID, payloadBytes, now).Scan(&id)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	ev := RealtimeEvent{
		ID:         id,
		Type:       evType,
		EntityType: entityType,
		EntityID:   entityID,
		Payload:    payload,
		CreatedAt:  formatTimeISO(now),
	}
	s.broadcastWS(ev)
}

func (s *Server) broadcastWS(ev RealtimeEvent) {
	s.wsMu.Lock()
	defer s.wsMu.Unlock()
	msg, err := json.Marshal(ev)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	for conn := range s.wsConns {
		_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg); err != nil {
			_ = conn.Close()
			delete(s.wsConns, conn)
		}
	}
}

func hashRequestPayload(raw []byte) string {
	var canonical any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical); err == nil {
		if b, err := json.Marshal(canonical); err == nil {
			raw = b
		}
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (s *Server) checkIdempotency(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, operation, key string, rawReq []byte) bool {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return false
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	var storedHash string
	var storedStatus int
	var storedResp []byte
	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT req_hash, status_code, response_body
		FROM idempotency_keys
		WHERE key = $1 AND operation = $2
	`, key, operation).Scan(&storedHash, &storedStatus, &storedResp)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if storedHash != reqHash {
		writeError(w, 409, "idempotency_conflict", "Idempotency key reused with different request payload")
		return true
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(storedStatus)
	_, _ = w.Write(storedResp)
	return true
}

func (s *Server) saveIdempotency(ctx context.Context, operation, key string, rawReq []byte, status int, dataPayload any) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	envelope := map[string]any{"data": dataPayload}
	respBytes, _ := json.Marshal(envelope)
	_, _ = s.db.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, operation, actor_id, req_hash, status_code, response_body)
		VALUES ($1, $2, '', $3, $4, $5)
		ON CONFLICT (key, operation) DO NOTHING
	`, key, operation, reqHash, status, respBytes)
}

func (s *Server) authenticateRequest(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request) (*AuthContext, error) {
	token := ""
	authHeader := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(authHeader), "bearer ") {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(authHeader[7:])
	}
	if token == "" {
		wsProto := r.Header.Get("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol")
		for _, part := range strings.Split(wsProto, ",") {
			p := strings.TrimSpace(part)
			if strings.HasPrefix(p, "bearer.") {
				token = strings.TrimPrefix(p, "bearer.")
				break
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(p), "bearer ") {
				token = strings.TrimSpace(p[7:])
				break
			} else if p != "" && p != "json" && p != "realtime" && len(p) > 16 {
				token = p
			}
		}
	}
	if token == "" {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("token"))
	}
	if token == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing token")
	}

	var userID uuid.UUID
	var username, fullName, activeRole string
	var roleSelected, active, available bool
	var rolesBytes, qualsBytes, certsBytes []byte
	var assignedLocID *uuid.UUID
	var capUnits int

	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.full_name, u.roles, u.qualifications, u.certifications,
		       u.active, u.assigned_location_id, u.available, u.capacity_units,
		       s.active_role, s.role_selected
		FROM sessions s
		JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
		WHERE s.token = $1
	`, token).Scan(
		&userID, &username, &fullName, &rolesBytes, &qualsBytes, &certsBytes,
		&active, &assignedLocID, &available, &capUnits,
		&activeRole, &roleSelected,
	)
	if err != nil || !active {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session")
	}

	var roles []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rolesBytes, &roles)
	var quals []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(qualsBytes, &quals)
	var certs []Certification
	_ = json.Unmarshal(certsBytes, &certs)

	if len(roles) == 1 && !roleSelected {
		activeRole = roles[0]
		roleSelected = true
	}
	if activeRole != "" && !hasString(roles, activeRole) {
		if len(roles) == 1 {
			activeRole = roles[0]
			roleSelected = true
		} else {
			activeRole = ""
			roleSelected = false
		}
	}

	return &AuthContext{
		UserID:             userID,
		Username:           username,
		FullName:           fullName,
		Roles:              roles,
		ActiveRole:         activeRole,
		RoleSelected:       roleSelected,
		Active:             active,
		AssignedLocationID: assignedLocID,
		Qualifications:     quals,
		Certifications:     certs,
		Available:          available,
		CapacityUnits:      capUnits,
		SessionToken:       token,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Server) requireRole(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, actionName string, allowedRoles ...string) (*AuthContext, bool) {
	auth, err := s.authenticateRequest(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, "anonymous", "none", actionName, "auth", "unauthorized", false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "unauthorized"})
		writeError(w, 401, "unauthorized", "Authentication required")
		return nil, false
	}
	if !auth.RoleSelected || auth.ActiveRole == "" {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), "unselected", actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "role_not_selected"})
		writeError(w, 409, "role_not_selected", "Active role must be selected first")
		return nil, false
	}
	if len(allowedRoles) > 0 && !hasString(allowedRoles, auth.ActiveRole) {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), auth.ActiveRole, actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "forbidden", "requiredRoles": allowedRoles})
		writeError(w, 403, "forbidden", "Active role is not permitted to perform this action")
		return nil, false
	}
	return auth, true
}

		db:      db,
		wsConns: make(map[*websocket.Conn]bool),
		upgrader: websocket.Upgrader{

}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}

func writeData(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]any{"data": data})
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string, msg string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{
		"error": msg,
		"code":  code,
	})
}

func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, dst any, allowEmpty bool) ([]byte, error) {
	bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(bodyBytes)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 {
		if allowEmpty {
			return []byte("{}"), nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty body")
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := dec.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trailing data")
	}
	return trimmed, nil
}

func parseTimeISO(s string) (time.Time, error) {
	if s == "" {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("empty time")
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid time: %s", s)
}

func formatTimeISO(t time.Time) string {
	return t.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
}

func haversineKm(c1, c2 Coordinate) float64 {
	const R = 6371.0
	lat1 := c1.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	lat2 := c2.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLat := (c2.Latitude - c1.Latitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLon := (c2.Longitude - c1.Longitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	a := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) +
		math.Cos(lat1)*math.Cos(lat2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)
	c := 2 * math.Atan2(math.Sqrt(a), math.Sqrt(1-a))
	return R * c
}

func validateCoordinate(c Coordinate) bool {
	if math.IsNaN(c.Latitude) || math.IsNaN(c.Longitude) {
		return false
	}
	return c.Latitude >= -90 && c.Latitude <= 90 && c.Longitude >= -180 && c.Longitude <= 180
}

func isValidRole(r string) bool {
	switch r {
	case "administrator", "dispatcher", "requester", "collection_professional", "delivery_partner", "node_handler", "laboratory_team":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func hasString(slice []string, val string) bool {
	for _, s := range slice {
		if s == val {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isLocationStale(recordedAt *time.Time, refTime time.Time) bool {
	if recordedAt == nil {
		return true
	}
	if refTime.IsZero() {
		refTime = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	diff := refTime.Sub(*recordedAt)
	return diff > 15*time.Minute
}

func (s *Server) recordAudit(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID string, success bool, occurredAt time.Time, details map[string]any) {
	if occurredAt.IsZero() {
		occurredAt = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	if details == nil {
		details = map[string]any{}
	}
	if actorID == "" {
		actorID = "anonymous"
	}
	if role == "" {
		role = "none"
	}
	detailsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(details)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO audit_logs (audit_id, actor_id, role, action, entity_type, entity_id, success, occurred_at, details)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
	`, uuid.New(), actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID, success, occurredAt, detailsBytes)
}

func (s *Server) publishEvent(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, evType, entityType, entityID string, payload map[string]any) {
	if payload == nil {
		payload = map[string]any{}
	}
	payloadBytes, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	var id int64
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO realtime_events (type, entity_type, entity_id, payload, created_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
		RETURNING id
	`, evType, entityType, entityID, payloadBytes, now).Scan(&id)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	ev := RealtimeEvent{
		ID:         id,
		Type:       evType,
		EntityType: entityType,
		EntityID:   entityID,
		Payload:    payload,
		CreatedAt:  formatTimeISO(now),
	}
	s.broadcastWS(ev)
}

func (s *Server) broadcastWS(ev RealtimeEvent) {
	s.wsMu.Lock()
	defer s.wsMu.Unlock()
	msg, err := json.Marshal(ev)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	for conn := range s.wsConns {
		_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg); err != nil {
			_ = conn.Close()
			delete(s.wsConns, conn)
		}
	}
}

func hashRequestPayload(raw []byte) string {
	var canonical any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical); err == nil {
		if b, err := json.Marshal(canonical); err == nil {
			raw = b
		}
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (s *Server) checkIdempotency(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, operation, key string, rawReq []byte) bool {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return false
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	var storedHash string
	var storedStatus int
	var storedResp []byte
	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT req_hash, status_code, response_body
		FROM idempotency_keys
		WHERE key = $1 AND operation = $2
	`, key, operation).Scan(&storedHash, &storedStatus, &storedResp)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if storedHash != reqHash {
		writeError(w, 409, "idempotency_conflict", "Idempotency key reused with different request payload")
		return true
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(storedStatus)
	_, _ = w.Write(storedResp)
	return true
}

func (s *Server) saveIdempotency(ctx context.Context, operation, key string, rawReq []byte, status int, dataPayload any) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	envelope := map[string]any{"data": dataPayload}
	respBytes, _ := json.Marshal(envelope)
	_, _ = s.db.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, operation, actor_id, req_hash, status_code, response_body)
		VALUES ($1, $2, '', $3, $4, $5)
		ON CONFLICT (key, operation) DO NOTHING
	`, key, operation, reqHash, status, respBytes)
}

func (s *Server) authenticateRequest(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request) (*AuthContext, error) {
	token := ""
	authHeader := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(authHeader), "bearer ") {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(authHeader[7:])
	}
	if token == "" {
		wsProto := r.Header.Get("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol")
		for _, part := range strings.Split(wsProto, ",") {
			p := strings.TrimSpace(part)
			if strings.HasPrefix(p, "bearer.") {
				token = strings.TrimPrefix(p, "bearer.")
				break
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(p), "bearer ") {
				token = strings.TrimSpace(p[7:])
				break
			} else if p != "" && p != "json" && p != "realtime" && len(p) > 16 {
				token = p
			}
		}
	}
	if token == "" {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("token"))
	}
	if token == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing token")
	}

	var userID uuid.UUID
	var username, fullName, activeRole string
	var roleSelected, active, available bool
	var rolesBytes, qualsBytes, certsBytes []byte
	var assignedLocID *uuid.UUID
	var capUnits int

	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.full_name, u.roles, u.qualifications, u.certifications,
		       u.active, u.assigned_location_id, u.available, u.capacity_units,
		       s.active_role, s.role_selected
		FROM sessions s
		JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
		WHERE s.token = $1
	`, token).Scan(
		&userID, &username, &fullName, &rolesBytes, &qualsBytes, &certsBytes,
		&active, &assignedLocID, &available, &capUnits,
		&activeRole, &roleSelected,
	)
	if err != nil || !active {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session")
	}

	var roles []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rolesBytes, &roles)
	var quals []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(qualsBytes, &quals)
	var certs []Certification
	_ = json.Unmarshal(certsBytes, &certs)

	if len(roles) == 1 && !roleSelected {
		activeRole = roles[0]
		roleSelected = true
	}
	if activeRole != "" && !hasString(roles, activeRole) {
		if len(roles) == 1 {
			activeRole = roles[0]
			roleSelected = true
		} else {
			activeRole = ""
			roleSelected = false
		}
	}

	return &AuthContext{
		UserID:             userID,
		Username:           username,
		FullName:           fullName,
		Roles:              roles,
		ActiveRole:         activeRole,
		RoleSelected:       roleSelected,
		Active:             active,
		AssignedLocationID: assignedLocID,
		Qualifications:     quals,
		Certifications:     certs,
		Available:          available,
		CapacityUnits:      capUnits,
		SessionToken:       token,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Server) requireRole(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, actionName string, allowedRoles ...string) (*AuthContext, bool) {
	auth, err := s.authenticateRequest(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, "anonymous", "none", actionName, "auth", "unauthorized", false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "unauthorized"})
		writeError(w, 401, "unauthorized", "Authentication required")
		return nil, false
	}
	if !auth.RoleSelected || auth.ActiveRole == "" {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), "unselected", actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "role_not_selected"})
		writeError(w, 409, "role_not_selected", "Active role must be selected first")
		return nil, false
	}
	if len(allowedRoles) > 0 && !hasString(allowedRoles, auth.ActiveRole) {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), auth.ActiveRole, actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "forbidden", "requiredRoles": allowedRoles})
		writeError(w, 403, "forbidden", "Active role is not permitted to perform this action")
		return nil, false
	}
	return auth, true
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}

func writeData(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]any{"data": data})
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string, msg string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{
		"error": msg,
		"code":  code,
	})
}

func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, dst any, allowEmpty bool) ([]byte, error) {
	bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(bodyBytes)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 {
		if allowEmpty {
			return []byte("{}"), nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty body")
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := dec.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trailing data")
	}
	return trimmed, nil
}

func parseTimeISO(s string) (time.Time, error) {
	if s == "" {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("empty time")
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid time: %s", s)
}

func formatTimeISO(t time.Time) string {
	return t.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
}

func haversineKm(c1, c2 Coordinate) float64 {
	const R = 6371.0
	lat1 := c1.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	lat2 := c2.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLat := (c2.Latitude - c1.Latitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLon := (c2.Longitude - c1.Longitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	a := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) +
		math.Cos(lat1)*math.Cos(lat2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)
	c := 2 * math.Atan2(math.Sqrt(a), math.Sqrt(1-a))
	return R * c
}

func validateCoordinate(c Coordinate) bool {
	if math.IsNaN(c.Latitude) || math.IsNaN(c.Longitude) {
		return false
	}
	return c.Latitude >= -90 && c.Latitude <= 90 && c.Longitude >= -180 && c.Longitude <= 180
}

func isValidRole(r string) bool {
	switch r {
	case "administrator", "dispatcher", "requester", "collection_professional", "delivery_partner", "node_handler", "laboratory_team":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func hasString(slice []string, val string) bool {
	for _, s := range slice {
		if s == val {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isLocationStale(recordedAt *time.Time, refTime time.Time) bool {
	if recordedAt == nil {
		return true
	}
	if refTime.IsZero() {
		refTime = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	diff := refTime.Sub(*recordedAt)
	return diff > 15*time.Minute
}

func (s *Server) recordAudit(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID string, success bool, occurredAt time.Time, details map[string]any) {
	if occurredAt.IsZero() {
		occurredAt = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	if details == nil {
		details = map[string]any{}
	}
	if actorID == "" {
		actorID = "anonymous"
	}
	if role == "" {
		role = "none"
	}
	detailsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(details)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO audit_logs (audit_id, actor_id, role, action, entity_type, entity_id, success, occurred_at, details)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
	`, uuid.New(), actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID, success, occurredAt, detailsBytes)
}

func (s *Server) publishEvent(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, evType, entityType, entityID string, payload map[string]any) {
	if payload == nil {
		payload = map[string]any{}
	}
	payloadBytes, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	var id int64
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO realtime_events (type, entity_type, entity_id, payload, created_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
		RETURNING id
	`, evType, entityType, entityID, payloadBytes, now).Scan(&id)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	ev := RealtimeEvent{
		ID:         id,
		Type:       evType,
		EntityType: entityType,
		EntityID:   entityID,
		Payload:    payload,
		CreatedAt:  formatTimeISO(now),
	}
	s.broadcastWS(ev)
}

func (s *Server) broadcastWS(ev RealtimeEvent) {
	s.wsMu.Lock()
	defer s.wsMu.Unlock()
	msg, err := json.Marshal(ev)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	for conn := range s.wsConns {
		_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg); err != nil {
			_ = conn.Close()
			delete(s.wsConns, conn)
		}
	}
}

func hashRequestPayload(raw []byte) string {
	var canonical any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical); err == nil {
		if b, err := json.Marshal(canonical); err == nil {
			raw = b
		}
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (s *Server) checkIdempotency(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, operation, key string, rawReq []byte) bool {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return false
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	var storedHash string
	var storedStatus int
	var storedResp []byte
	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT req_hash, status_code, response_body
		FROM idempotency_keys
		WHERE key = $1 AND operation = $2
	`, key, operation).Scan(&storedHash, &storedStatus, &storedResp)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if storedHash != reqHash {
		writeError(w, 409, "idempotency_conflict", "Idempotency key reused with different request payload")
		return true
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(storedStatus)
	_, _ = w.Write(storedResp)
	return true
}

func (s *Server) saveIdempotency(ctx context.Context, operation, key string, rawReq []byte, status int, dataPayload any) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	envelope := map[string]any{"data": dataPayload}
	respBytes, _ := json.Marshal(envelope)
	_, _ = s.db.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, operation, actor_id, req_hash, status_code, response_body)
		VALUES ($1, $2, '', $3, $4, $5)
		ON CONFLICT (key, operation) DO NOTHING
	`, key, operation, reqHash, status, respBytes)
}

func (s *Server) authenticateRequest(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request) (*AuthContext, error) {
	token := ""
	authHeader := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(authHeader), "bearer ") {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(authHeader[7:])
	}
	if token == "" {
		wsProto := r.Header.Get("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol")
		for _, part := range strings.Split(wsProto, ",") {
			p := strings.TrimSpace(part)
			if strings.HasPrefix(p, "bearer.") {
				token = strings.TrimPrefix(p, "bearer.")
				break
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(p), "bearer ") {
				token = strings.TrimSpace(p[7:])
				break
			} else if p != "" && p != "json" && p != "realtime" && len(p) > 16 {
				token = p
			}
		}
	}
	if token == "" {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("token"))
	}
	if token == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing token")
	}

	var userID uuid.UUID
	var username, fullName, activeRole string
	var roleSelected, active, available bool
	var rolesBytes, qualsBytes, certsBytes []byte
	var assignedLocID *uuid.UUID
	var capUnits int

	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.full_name, u.roles, u.qualifications, u.certifications,
		       u.active, u.assigned_location_id, u.available, u.capacity_units,
		       s.active_role, s.role_selected
		FROM sessions s
		JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
		WHERE s.token = $1
	`, token).Scan(
		&userID, &username, &fullName, &rolesBytes, &qualsBytes, &certsBytes,
		&active, &assignedLocID, &available, &capUnits,
		&activeRole, &roleSelected,
	)
	if err != nil || !active {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session")
	}

	var roles []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rolesBytes, &roles)
	var quals []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(qualsBytes, &quals)
	var certs []Certification
	_ = json.Unmarshal(certsBytes, &certs)

	if len(roles) == 1 && !roleSelected {
		activeRole = roles[0]
		roleSelected = true
	}
	if activeRole != "" && !hasString(roles, activeRole) {
		if len(roles) == 1 {
			activeRole = roles[0]
			roleSelected = true
		} else {
			activeRole = ""
			roleSelected = false
		}
	}

	return &AuthContext{
		UserID:             userID,
		Username:           username,
		FullName:           fullName,
		Roles:              roles,
		ActiveRole:         activeRole,
		RoleSelected:       roleSelected,
		Active:             active,
		AssignedLocationID: assignedLocID,
		Qualifications:     quals,
		Certifications:     certs,
		Available:          available,
		CapacityUnits:      capUnits,
		SessionToken:       token,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Server) requireRole(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, actionName string, allowedRoles ...string) (*AuthContext, bool) {
	auth, err := s.authenticateRequest(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, "anonymous", "none", actionName, "auth", "unauthorized", false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "unauthorized"})
		writeError(w, 401, "unauthorized", "Authentication required")
		return nil, false
	}
	if !auth.RoleSelected || auth.ActiveRole == "" {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), "unselected", actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "role_not_selected"})
		writeError(w, 409, "role_not_selected", "Active role must be selected first")
		return nil, false
	}
	if len(allowedRoles) > 0 && !hasString(allowedRoles, auth.ActiveRole) {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), auth.ActiveRole, actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "forbidden", "requiredRoles": allowedRoles})
		writeError(w, 403, "forbidden", "Active role is not permitted to perform this action")
		return nil, false
	}
	return auth, true
}

}

type AuthContext struct {
	UserID             uuid.UUID
	Username           string
	FullName           string
	Roles              []string
	ActiveRole         string
	RoleSelected       bool
	Active             bool
	AssignedLocationID *uuid.UUID
	Qualifications     []string
	Certifications     []Certification
	Available          bool
	CapacityUnits      int
	SessionToken       string

type Server struct {
	db       *pgxpool.Pool
	wsMu     sync.Mutex
	wsConns  map[*websocket.Conn]bool
	upgrader websocket.Upgrader
}

func NewServer(db *pgxpool.Pool) *Server {
	return &Server{
		db:      db,
		wsConns: make(map[*websocket.Conn]bool),
		upgrader: websocket.Upgrader{
			CheckOrigin: func(r *http.Request) bool { return true },
		},
	}
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}

func writeData(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]any{"data": data})
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string, msg string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{
		"error": msg,
		"code":  code,
	})
}

func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, dst any, allowEmpty bool) ([]byte, error) {
	bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(bodyBytes)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 {
		if allowEmpty {
			return []byte("{}"), nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty body")
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := dec.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trailing data")
	}
	return trimmed, nil
}

func parseTimeISO(s string) (time.Time, error) {
	if s == "" {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("empty time")
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid time: %s", s)
}

func formatTimeISO(t time.Time) string {
	return t.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
}

func haversineKm(c1, c2 Coordinate) float64 {
	const R = 6371.0
	lat1 := c1.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	lat2 := c2.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLat := (c2.Latitude - c1.Latitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLon := (c2.Longitude - c1.Longitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	a := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) +
		math.Cos(lat1)*math.Cos(lat2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)
	c := 2 * math.Atan2(math.Sqrt(a), math.Sqrt(1-a))
	return R * c
}

func validateCoordinate(c Coordinate) bool {
	if math.IsNaN(c.Latitude) || math.IsNaN(c.Longitude) {
		return false
	}
	return c.Latitude >= -90 && c.Latitude <= 90 && c.Longitude >= -180 && c.Longitude <= 180
}

func isValidRole(r string) bool {
	switch r {
	case "administrator", "dispatcher", "requester", "collection_professional", "delivery_partner", "node_handler", "laboratory_team":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func hasString(slice []string, val string) bool {
	for _, s := range slice {
		if s == val {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isLocationStale(recordedAt *time.Time, refTime time.Time) bool {
	if recordedAt == nil {
		return true
	}
	if refTime.IsZero() {
		refTime = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	diff := refTime.Sub(*recordedAt)
	return diff > 15*time.Minute
}

func (s *Server) recordAudit(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID string, success bool, occurredAt time.Time, details map[string]any) {
	if occurredAt.IsZero() {
		occurredAt = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	if details == nil {
		details = map[string]any{}
	}
	if actorID == "" {
		actorID = "anonymous"
	}
	if role == "" {
		role = "none"
	}
	detailsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(details)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO audit_logs (audit_id, actor_id, role, action, entity_type, entity_id, success, occurred_at, details)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
	`, uuid.New(), actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID, success, occurredAt, detailsBytes)
}

func (s *Server) publishEvent(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, evType, entityType, entityID string, payload map[string]any) {
	if payload == nil {
		payload = map[string]any{}
	}
	payloadBytes, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	var id int64
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO realtime_events (type, entity_type, entity_id, payload, created_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
		RETURNING id
	`, evType, entityType, entityID, payloadBytes, now).Scan(&id)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	ev := RealtimeEvent{
		ID:         id,
		Type:       evType,
		EntityType: entityType,
		EntityID:   entityID,
		Payload:    payload,
		CreatedAt:  formatTimeISO(now),
	}
	s.broadcastWS(ev)
}

func (s *Server) broadcastWS(ev RealtimeEvent) {
	s.wsMu.Lock()
	defer s.wsMu.Unlock()
	msg, err := json.Marshal(ev)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	for conn := range s.wsConns {
		_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg); err != nil {
			_ = conn.Close()
			delete(s.wsConns, conn)
		}
	}
}

func hashRequestPayload(raw []byte) string {
	var canonical any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical); err == nil {
		if b, err := json.Marshal(canonical); err == nil {
			raw = b
		}
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (s *Server) checkIdempotency(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, operation, key string, rawReq []byte) bool {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return false
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	var storedHash string
	var storedStatus int
	var storedResp []byte
	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT req_hash, status_code, response_body
		FROM idempotency_keys
		WHERE key = $1 AND operation = $2
	`, key, operation).Scan(&storedHash, &storedStatus, &storedResp)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if storedHash != reqHash {
		writeError(w, 409, "idempotency_conflict", "Idempotency key reused with different request payload")
		return true
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(storedStatus)
	_, _ = w.Write(storedResp)
	return true
}

func (s *Server) saveIdempotency(ctx context.Context, operation, key string, rawReq []byte, status int, dataPayload any) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	envelope := map[string]any{"data": dataPayload}
	respBytes, _ := json.Marshal(envelope)
	_, _ = s.db.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, operation, actor_id, req_hash, status_code, response_body)
		VALUES ($1, $2, '', $3, $4, $5)
		ON CONFLICT (key, operation) DO NOTHING
	`, key, operation, reqHash, status, respBytes)
}

func (s *Server) authenticateRequest(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request) (*AuthContext, error) {
	token := ""
	authHeader := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(authHeader), "bearer ") {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(authHeader[7:])
	}
	if token == "" {
		wsProto := r.Header.Get("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol")
		for _, part := range strings.Split(wsProto, ",") {
			p := strings.TrimSpace(part)
			if strings.HasPrefix(p, "bearer.") {
				token = strings.TrimPrefix(p, "bearer.")
				break
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(p), "bearer ") {
				token = strings.TrimSpace(p[7:])
				break
			} else if p != "" && p != "json" && p != "realtime" && len(p) > 16 {
				token = p
			}
		}
	}
	if token == "" {
		token = strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("token"))
	}
	if token == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing token")
	}

	var userID uuid.UUID
	var username, fullName, activeRole string
	var roleSelected, active, available bool
	var rolesBytes, qualsBytes, certsBytes []byte
	var assignedLocID *uuid.UUID
	var capUnits int

	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.full_name, u.roles, u.qualifications, u.certifications,
		       u.active, u.assigned_location_id, u.available, u.capacity_units,
		       s.active_role, s.role_selected
		FROM sessions s
		JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
		WHERE s.token = $1
	`, token).Scan(
		&userID, &username, &fullName, &rolesBytes, &qualsBytes, &certsBytes,
		&active, &assignedLocID, &available, &capUnits,
		&activeRole, &roleSelected,
	)
	if err != nil || !active {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session")
	}

	var roles []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rolesBytes, &roles)
	var quals []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(qualsBytes, &quals)
	var certs []Certification
	_ = json.Unmarshal(certsBytes, &certs)

	if len(roles) == 1 && !roleSelected {
		activeRole = roles[0]
		roleSelected = true
	}
	if activeRole != "" && !hasString(roles, activeRole) {
		if len(roles) == 1 {
			activeRole = roles[0]
			roleSelected = true
		} else {
			activeRole = ""
			roleSelected = false
		}
	}

	return &AuthContext{
		UserID:             userID,
		Username:           username,
		FullName:           fullName,
		Roles:              roles,
		ActiveRole:         activeRole,
		RoleSelected:       roleSelected,
		Active:             active,
		AssignedLocationID: assignedLocID,
		Qualifications:     quals,
		Certifications:     certs,
		Available:          available,
		CapacityUnits:      capUnits,
		SessionToken:       token,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Server) requireRole(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, actionName string, allowedRoles ...string) (*AuthContext, bool) {
	auth, err := s.authenticateRequest(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, "anonymous", "none", actionName, "auth", "unauthorized", false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "unauthorized"})
		writeError(w, 401, "unauthorized", "Authentication required")
		return nil, false
	}
	if !auth.RoleSelected || auth.ActiveRole == "" {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), "unselected", actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "role_not_selected"})
		writeError(w, 409, "role_not_selected", "Active role must be selected first")
		return nil, false
	}
	if len(allowedRoles) > 0 && !hasString(allowedRoles, auth.ActiveRole) {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), auth.ActiveRole, actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "forbidden", "requiredRoles": allowedRoles})
		writeError(w, 403, "forbidden", "Active role is not permitted to perform this action")
		return nil, false
	}
	return auth, true
}
