package main

import (
        "context"
        "crypto/hmac"
        "crypto/sha256"
        "encoding/hex"
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
        "os"
        "time"

        "github.com/google/uuid"
        "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

const schemaSQL = `
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        user_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        email TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        full_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        phone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        roles JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        qualifications JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        certifications JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
        assigned_location_id UUID,
        available BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
        capacity_units INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5,
        assignment_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        decline_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        last_declined_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        last_offered_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        latest_lat DOUBLE PRECISION,
        latest_lng DOUBLE PRECISION,
        location_recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        location_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_username ON users(username);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_users_assigned_location ON users(assigned_location_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (
        token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        active_role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        role_selected BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_user_id ON sessions(user_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (
        location_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        coverage_km DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 5.0,
        handling_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
        fn_collection_point BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        fn_transfer_point BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        fn_hub BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        fn_laboratory BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        capacity_units INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
        reserved_units INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        cooled_capacity_units INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
        cooled_reserved_units INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_locations_active ON locations(active);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS connections (
        connection_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        from_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(location_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        to_location_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(location_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        travel_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL,
        cost_units DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 1.0,
        cooled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
        capacity_units INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
        reserved_units INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        cooled_capacity_units INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,
        cooled_reserved_units INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_connections_from_to ON connections(from_location_id, to_location_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sample_types (
        sample_type_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
        qualified_collector_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
        required_qualification TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        container_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        temperature_min_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        temperature_max_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        incompatible_sample_types JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        requires_cooled_route BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        batching_allowed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sample_types_name ON sample_types(name);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lab_acceptances (
        acceptance_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        laboratory_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES locations(location_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        sample_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sample_types(sample_type_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        accepts BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
        UNIQUE(laboratory_id, sample_type_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_lab_acceptances_lab ON lab_acceptances(laboratory_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS serviceability_snapshots (
        version SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'complete',
        computed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
        network_revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        regions JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        active_collection_point_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS requests (
        request_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        requester_id UUID NOT NULL,
        origin_lat DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        origin_lng DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        origin_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'home',
        origin_node_id UUID,
        requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        delivery_deadline TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        earliest_collection_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        latest_collection_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        sample_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sample_types(sample_type_id),
        container_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        temperature_min_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        temperature_max_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        incompatible_sample_types JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        serviceability TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'serviceable',
        serviceability_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'serviceable',
        presealed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_requests_requester_id ON requests(requester_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS samples (
        sample_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        request_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(request_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        requester_id UUID NOT NULL,
        sample_type_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES sample_types(sample_type_id),
        origin_lat DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        origin_lng DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        origin_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'home',
        origin_node_id UUID,
        requested_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        delivery_deadline TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        earliest_collection_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        latest_collection_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        container_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        temperature_min_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        temperature_max_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        incompatible_sample_types JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        serviceability TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'serviceable',
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested',
        sealed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        sealed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        current_holder_id UUID,
        active_journey_id UUID,
        target_laboratory_id UUID,
        received_laboratory_id UUID,
        received_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        latest_lat DOUBLE PRECISION,
        latest_lng DOUBLE PRECISION,
        location_recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        exception_data JSONB,
        active_replacement_plan_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_samples_requester ON samples(requester_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_samples_active_journey ON samples(active_journey_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_samples_status ON samples(status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journeys (
        journey_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        parent_journey_id UUID,
        plan_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        route_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'direct',
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',
        estimated_delivery_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        total_cost_units DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        capacity_used INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        capacity_available INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        sample_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        valid BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
        replan_status TEXT,
        replacement_journey_id UUID,
        split_journey_id UUID,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_journeys_status ON journeys(status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS journey_stops (
        stop_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        journey_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journeys(journey_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        location_id UUID NOT NULL,
        stop_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
        estimated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        dwell_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_journey_stops_journey ON journey_stops(journey_id, sequence);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assignments (
        assignment_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        journey_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journeys(journey_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(sample_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
        worker_id UUID,
        offered_to_worker_id UUID,
        offer_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        declined_by JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        from_location_id UUID,
        to_location_id UUID,
        node_id UUID,
        incoming_from_location_id UUID,
        outgoing_to_location_id UUID,
        laboratory_id UUID,
        connection_id UUID,
        expected_sample_type_id UUID,
        started_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        completed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        last_progress_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assignments_journey ON assignments(journey_id, sequence);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assignments_sample ON assignments(sample_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assignments_worker ON assignments(worker_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_assignments_offered ON assignments(offered_to_worker_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS capacity_reservations (
        reservation_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        journey_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journeys(journey_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(sample_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        resource_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        resource_id UUID NOT NULL,
        units INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        cooled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cap_res_journey ON capacity_reservations(journey_id, active);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cap_res_resource ON capacity_reservations(resource_id, active);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS handoffs (
        handoff_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(sample_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        journey_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES journeys(journey_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        from_assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments(assignment_id),
        to_assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments(assignment_id),
        sender_id UUID NOT NULL,
        receiver_id UUID NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
        sender_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        receiver_confirmed BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
        initiated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        sender_confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        receiver_confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        confirmed_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
        active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_handoffs_sample ON handoffs(sample_id, active);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS checkpoints (
        checkpoint_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(sample_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        assignment_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES assignments(assignment_id),
        location_id UUID,
        actor_id UUID NOT NULL,
        container_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        observed_temperature_c DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL,
        compliant BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
        recorded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_checkpoints_sample ON checkpoints(sample_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS exceptions (
        exception_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        sample_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES samples(sample_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        laboratory_id UUID,
        reason TEXT NOT NULL,
        details JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
        observed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_exceptions_sample ON exceptions(sample_id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS disruptions (
        disruption_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
        resource_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
        affected_sample_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        replacement_plan_ids JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb,
        replan_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_required'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs (
        event_id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        audit_id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
        actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        role TEXT NOT NULL,
        action TEXT NOT NULL,
        entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        success BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
        occurred_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
        details JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_logs_entity ON audit_logs(entity_type, entity_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_logs_actor ON audit_logs(actor_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_logs_action ON audit_logs(action);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_audit_logs_occurred ON audit_logs(occurred_at);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS realtime_events (
        id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
        type TEXT NOT NULL,
        entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_realtime_events_id ON realtime_events(id);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS idempotency_keys (
        key TEXT NOT NULL,
        operation TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        req_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
        status_code INTEGER NOT NULL,
        response_body JSONB NOT NULL,
        created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
        PRIMARY KEY (key, operation)
);
`

const dropAllSQL = `
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS
        idempotency_keys,
        realtime_events,
        audit_logs,
        disruptions,
        exceptions,
        checkpoints,
        handoffs,
        capacity_reservations,
        assignments,
        journey_stops,
        journeys,
        samples,
        requests,
        serviceability_snapshots,
        lab_acceptances,
        sample_types,
        connections,
        locations,
        sessions,
        users
CASCADE;
`

func hashPassword(password string) string {
        mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte("labsample-secret-salt-v1"))
        mac.Write([]byte(password))
        return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

func connectDB(ctx context.Context) (*pgxpool.Pool, error) {
        dbURL := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
        if dbURL == "" {
                dbURL = "postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena?sslmode=disable"
        }
        cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dbURL)
        if err != nil {
                return nil, err
        }
        cfg.MaxConns = 25
        return pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
}

func resetDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
        if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, dropAllSQL); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("drop tables: %w", err)
        }
        if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
        }
        if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
        }
        if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
}

func initDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
        if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
        }
        if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
        }
        if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
        }
        if err := ensureInitialAdmin(ctx, pool); err != nil {
                return fmt.Errorf("ensure initial admin: %w", err)
        }
        return nil
}

// Deterministic UUIDs for the 4 default sample types if created on fresh DB
var (
        amberTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111101")
        indigoTypeID = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111102")
        frostTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111103")
        pulseTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111104")
)

func seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
        type defaultST struct {
                ID           uuid.UUID
                Name         string
                Qual         string
                Container    string
                TempMin      float64
                TempMax      float64
                Incompatible []string
                Cooled       bool
                Batching     bool
        }
        defaults := []defaultST{
                {
                        ID:           amberTypeID,
                        Name:         "Amber",
                        Qual:         "Amber",
                        Container:    "standard-vial",
                        TempMin:      15,
                        TempMax:      25,
                        Incompatible: []string{indigoTypeID.String()},
                        Cooled:       false,
                        Batching:     true,
                },
                {
                        ID:           indigoTypeID,
                        Name:         "Indigo",
                        Qual:         "Indigo",
                        Container:    "indigo-tube",
                        TempMin:      15,
                        TempMax:      25,
                        Incompatible: []string{amberTypeID.String()},
                        Cooled:       false,
                        Batching:     true,
                },
                {
                        ID:           frostTypeID,
                        Name:         "Frost",
                        Qual:         "Frost",
                        Container:    "cryo-vial",
                        TempMin:      2,
                        TempMax:      8,
                        Incompatible: []string{},
                        Cooled:       true,
                        Batching:     true,
                },
                {
                        ID:           pulseTypeID,
                        Name:         "Pulse",
                        Qual:         "Pulse",
                        Container:    "stat-carrier",
                        TempMin:      15,
                        TempMax:      25,
                        Incompatible: []string{},
                        Cooled:       false,
                        Batching:     false,
                },
        }

        for _, d := range defaults {
                incJSON, _ := json.Marshal(d.Incompatible)
                _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
                        INSERT INTO sample_types (
                                sample_type_id, name, qualified_collector_required, required_qualification,
                                container_type, temperature_min_c, temperature_max_c,
                                incompatible_sample_types, requires_cooled_route, batching_allowed
                        ) VALUES ($1, $2, TRUE, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
                        ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
                `, d.ID, d.Name, d.Qual, d.Container, d.TempMin, d.TempMax, incJSON, d.Cooled, d.Batching)
                if err != nil {
                        return err
                }
        }
        return nil
}

func ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
        var count int
        if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serviceability_snapshots`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
                return err
        }
        if count == 0 {
                _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
                        INSERT INTO serviceability_snapshots (status, computed_at, network_revision, regions, active_collection_point_count)
                        VALUES ('complete', $1, 0, '[]'::jsonb, 0)
                `, time.Now().UTC())
                return err
        }
        return nil
}

func ensureInitialAdmin(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
        var count int
        if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
                return err
        }
        if count > 0 {
                return nil
        }
        username := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
        password := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
        if username == "" {
                username = "admin"
        }
        if password == "" {
                password = "admin"
        }
        adminID := uuid.New()
        rolesJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{"administrator"})
        qualsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{})
        certsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]any{})
        _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
                INSERT INTO users (
                        user_id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone,
                        roles, qualifications, certifications, active, available, capacity_units
                ) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, '', $6, $7, $8, TRUE, TRUE, 10)
        `, adminID, username, hashPassword(password), username+"@labsample.local", "System Administrator", rolesJSON, qualsJSON, certsJSON)
        return err
}

func (s *Server) loadTimelineForEntities(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, entityIDs ...string) []TimelineEntry {
        if len(entityIDs) == 0 {
                return []TimelineEntry{}
        }
        rows, err := q.Query(ctx, `
                SELECT event_id, action, actor_id, role, entity_type, entity_id, success, occurred_at, details
                FROM audit_logs
                WHERE entity_id = ANY($1)
                ORDER BY occurred_at ASC, event_id ASC
        `, entityIDs)
        if err != nil {
                return []TimelineEntry{}
        }
        defer rows.Close()
        out := []TimelineEntry{}
        for rows.Next() {
                var te TimelineEntry
                var occ time.Time
                var detB []byte
                if err := rows.Scan(&te.EventID, &te.Action, &te.ActorID, &te.Role, &te.EntityType, &te.EntityID, &te.Success, &occ, &detB); err == nil {
                        te.OccurredAt = formatTimeISO(occ)
                        _ = json.Unmarshal(detB, &te.Details)
                        if te.Details == nil {
                                te.Details = map[string]any{}
                        }
                        out = append(out, te)
                }
        }
        return out
}

	if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialAdmin(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("ensure initial admin: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// Deterministic UUIDs for the 4 default sample types if created on fresh DB
var (
	amberTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111101")
	indigoTypeID = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111102")
	frostTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111103")
	pulseTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111104")
)

func seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	type defaultST struct {
		ID           uuid.UUID
		Name         string
		Qual         string
		Container    string
		TempMin      float64
		TempMax      float64
		Incompatible []string
		Cooled       bool
		Batching     bool
	}
	defaults := []defaultST{
		{
			ID:           amberTypeID,
			Name:         "Amber",
			Qual:         "Amber",
			Container:    "standard-vial",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{indigoTypeID.String()},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           indigoTypeID,
			Name:         "Indigo",
			Qual:         "Indigo",
			Container:    "indigo-tube",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{amberTypeID.String()},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           frostTypeID,
			Name:         "Frost",
			Qual:         "Frost",
			Container:    "cryo-vial",
			TempMin:      2,
			TempMax:      8,
			Incompatible: []string{},
			Cooled:       true,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           pulseTypeID,
			Name:         "Pulse",
			Qual:         "Pulse",
			Container:    "stat-carrier",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     false,
		},
	}

	for _, d := range defaults {
		incJSON, _ := json.Marshal(d.Incompatible)
		_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
			INSERT INTO sample_types (
				sample_type_id, name, qualified_collector_required, required_qualification,
				container_type, temperature_min_c, temperature_max_c,
				incompatible_sample_types, requires_cooled_route, batching_allowed
			) VALUES ($1, $2, TRUE, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
			ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
		`, d.ID, d.Name, d.Qual, d.Container, d.TempMin, d.TempMax, incJSON, d.Cooled, d.Batching)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	var count int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serviceability_snapshots`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if count == 0 {
		_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
			INSERT INTO serviceability_snapshots (status, computed_at, network_revision, regions, active_collection_point_count)
			VALUES ('complete', $1, 0, '[]'::jsonb, 0)
		`, time.Now().UTC())
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureInitialAdmin(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	var count int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if count > 0 {
		return nil
	}
	username := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	password := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if username == "" {
		username = "admin"
	}
	if password == "" {
		password = "admin"
	}
	adminID := uuid.New()
	rolesJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{"administrator"})
	qualsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{})
	certsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]any{})
	_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO users (
			user_id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone,
			roles, qualifications, certifications, active, available, capacity_units
		) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, '', $6, $7, $8, TRUE, TRUE, 10)
	`, adminID, username, hashPassword(password), username+"@labsample.local", "System Administrator", rolesJSON, qualsJSON, certsJSON)
	return err
}

func hashPassword(password string) string {
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte("labsample-secret-salt-v1"))
	mac.Write([]byte(password))
	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

func connectDB(ctx context.Context) (*pgxpool.Pool, error) {
	dbURL := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
	if dbURL == "" {
		dbURL = "postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena?sslmode=disable"
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dbURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cfg.MaxConns = 25
	return pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
}

func resetDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, dropAllSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("drop tables: %w", err)
	}
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
	}
	if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func initDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
	}
	if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialAdmin(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("ensure initial admin: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// Deterministic UUIDs for the 4 default sample types if created on fresh DB
var (
	amberTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111101")
	indigoTypeID = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111102")
	frostTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111103")
	pulseTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111104")
)

func seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	type defaultST struct {
		ID           uuid.UUID
		Name         string
		Qual         string
		Container    string
		TempMin      float64
		TempMax      float64
		Incompatible []string
		Cooled       bool
		Batching     bool
	}
	defaults := []defaultST{
		{
			ID:           amberTypeID,
			Name:         "Amber",
			Qual:         "Amber",
			Container:    "standard-vial",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{indigoTypeID.String()},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           indigoTypeID,
			Name:         "Indigo",
			Qual:         "Indigo",
			Container:    "indigo-tube",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{amberTypeID.String()},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           frostTypeID,
			Name:         "Frost",
			Qual:         "Frost",
			Container:    "cryo-vial",
			TempMin:      2,
			TempMax:      8,
			Incompatible: []string{},
			Cooled:       true,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           pulseTypeID,
			Name:         "Pulse",
			Qual:         "Pulse",
			Container:    "stat-carrier",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     false,
		},
	}

	for _, d := range defaults {
		incJSON, _ := json.Marshal(d.Incompatible)
		_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
			INSERT INTO sample_types (
				sample_type_id, name, qualified_collector_required, required_qualification,
				container_type, temperature_min_c, temperature_max_c,
				incompatible_sample_types, requires_cooled_route, batching_allowed
			) VALUES ($1, $2, TRUE, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
			ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
		`, d.ID, d.Name, d.Qual, d.Container, d.TempMin, d.TempMax, incJSON, d.Cooled, d.Batching)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	var count int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serviceability_snapshots`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if count == 0 {
		_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
			INSERT INTO serviceability_snapshots (status, computed_at, network_revision, regions, active_collection_point_count)
			VALUES ('complete', $1, 0, '[]'::jsonb, 0)
		`, time.Now().UTC())
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureInitialAdmin(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	var count int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if count > 0 {
		return nil
	}
	username := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	password := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if username == "" {
		username = "admin"
	}
	if password == "" {
		password = "admin"
	}
	adminID := uuid.New()
	rolesJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{"administrator"})
	qualsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{})
	certsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]any{})
	_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO users (
			user_id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone,
			roles, qualifications, certifications, active, available, capacity_units
		) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, '', $6, $7, $8, TRUE, TRUE, 10)
	`, adminID, username, hashPassword(password), username+"@labsample.local", "System Administrator", rolesJSON, qualsJSON, certsJSON)
	return err
}

func hashPassword(password string) string {
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte("labsample-secret-salt-v1"))
	mac.Write([]byte(password))
	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

func connectDB(ctx context.Context) (*pgxpool.Pool, error) {
	dbURL := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
	if dbURL == "" {
		dbURL = "postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena?sslmode=disable"
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dbURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cfg.MaxConns = 25
	return pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
}

func resetDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, dropAllSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("drop tables: %w", err)
	}
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
	}
	if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func initDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
	}
	if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialAdmin(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("ensure initial admin: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	type defaultST struct {
		ID           uuid.UUID
		Name         string
		Qual         string
		Container    string
		TempMin      float64
		TempMax      float64
		Incompatible []string
		Cooled       bool
		Batching     bool
	}
	defaults := []defaultST{
		{
			ID:           amberTypeID,
			Name:         "Amber",
			Qual:         "Amber",
			Container:    "standard-vial",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{indigoTypeID.String()},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           indigoTypeID,
			Name:         "Indigo",
			Qual:         "Indigo",
			Container:    "indigo-tube",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{amberTypeID.String()},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           frostTypeID,
			Name:         "Frost",
			Qual:         "Frost",
			Container:    "cryo-vial",
			TempMin:      2,
			TempMax:      8,
			Incompatible: []string{},
			Cooled:       true,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           pulseTypeID,
			Name:         "Pulse",
			Qual:         "Pulse",
			Container:    "stat-carrier",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     false,
		},
	}

	for _, d := range defaults {
		incJSON, _ := json.Marshal(d.Incompatible)
		_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
			INSERT INTO sample_types (
				sample_type_id, name, qualified_collector_required, required_qualification,
				container_type, temperature_min_c, temperature_max_c,
				incompatible_sample_types, requires_cooled_route, batching_allowed
			) VALUES ($1, $2, TRUE, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
			ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
		`, d.ID, d.Name, d.Qual, d.Container, d.TempMin, d.TempMax, incJSON, d.Cooled, d.Batching)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	var count int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM serviceability_snapshots`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if count == 0 {
		_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
			INSERT INTO serviceability_snapshots (status, computed_at, network_revision, regions, active_collection_point_count)
			VALUES ('complete', $1, 0, '[]'::jsonb, 0)
		`, time.Now().UTC())
		return err
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureInitialAdmin(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	var count int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if count > 0 {
		return nil
	}
	username := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	password := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if username == "" {
		username = "admin"
	}
	if password == "" {
		password = "admin"
	}
	adminID := uuid.New()
	rolesJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{"administrator"})
	qualsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{})
	certsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]any{})
	_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO users (
			user_id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone,
			roles, qualifications, certifications, active, available, capacity_units
		) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, '', $6, $7, $8, TRUE, TRUE, 10)
	`, adminID, username, hashPassword(password), username+"@labsample.local", "System Administrator", rolesJSON, qualsJSON, certsJSON)
	return err
}

python3 -c '
import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, uuid, subprocess, time, os, signal
from jsonschema import validate, RefResolver

spec = json.load(open("/workspace/contracts/openapi.contract.json"))
resolver = RefResolver.from_schema(spec)

def validate_resp(path, method, status, body):
    op = spec["paths"][path][method.lower()]
    resp_spec = op["responses"].get(str(status))
    assert resp_spec is not None, f"Unexpected status {status} for {method} {path}: {body}"
    schema = resp_spec["content"]["application/json"]["schema"]
    validate(instance=body, schema=schema, resolver=resolver)

def req(method, path, data=None, token=None):
    url = "http://127.0.0.1:18082" + path
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    if token:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
    body_bytes = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8") if data is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body_bytes, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
            b = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
            return resp.status, b
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raw = e.read().decode("utf-8")
        b = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
        return e.code, b

subprocess.run(["/workspace/backend/server", "reset"], check=True)
env = os.environ.copy()
env["PORT"] = "18082"
env["ADMIN_USERNAME"] = "admin"
env["ADMIN_PASSWORD"] = "adminpass"
proc = subprocess.Popen(["/workspace/backend/server"], env=env)
time.sleep(1)

try:
    # 1. /ready
    st, b = req("GET", "/ready")
    assert st == 200 and b == {"status": "ready"}
    validate_resp("/ready", "GET", st, b)

    # 2. /api/authenticate-user (invalid)
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": "admin", "password": "wrong"})
    assert st == 401
    validate_resp("/api/authenticate-user", "POST", st, b)

    # 3. /api/authenticate-user (valid admin)
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": "admin", "password": "adminpass"})
    assert st == 200, f"got {st}: {b}"
    validate_resp("/api/authenticate-user", "POST", st, b)
    admin_token = b["data"]["accessToken"]
    admin_id = b["data"]["userId"]

    # 4. /api/select-active-role
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": "administrator", "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())}, admin_token)
    assert st == 201, f"got {st}: {b}"
    validate_resp("/api/select-active-role", "POST", st, b)

    # 5. /api/ui/bootstrap
    st, b = req("GET", "/api/ui/bootstrap", token=admin_token)
    assert st == 200, f"got {st}: {b}"
    validate_resp("/api/ui/bootstrap", "GET", st, b)
    sample_types = {st_item["name"]: st_item["sampleTypeId"] for st_item in b["data"]["sampleTypes"]}
    assert {"Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse"}.issubset(sample_types.keys()), f"Missing default sample types: {sample_types}"

    # 6. /api/create-location (Collection Point, Hub, Lab)
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-location", {
        "name": "Central Collection Point",
        "latitude": 12.9716,
        "longitude": 77.5946,
        "functions": ["collection_point"],
        "coverageKm": 5.0,
        "handlingMinutes": 5,
        "capacityUnits": 10,
        "cooledCapacityUnits": 5,
        "active": True,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, admin_token)

    op = spec["paths"][path_template][method.lower()]

def validate_resp(path_template, method, status, body):
    op = spec["paths"][path_template][method.lower()]
    resp_spec = op["responses"].get(str(status))
    assert resp_spec is not None, f"Unexpected status {status} for {method} {path_template}: {body}"
    schema = resp_spec["content"]["application/json"]["schema"]
    validate(instance=body, schema=schema, resolver=resolver)

def req(method, path, data=None, token=None, path_template=None):
    if path_template is None:

    if token:

            b = json.loads(raw) if raw else None

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=DeprecationWarning)
from jsonschema import validate, RefResolver

spec = json.load(open("/workspace/contracts/openapi.contract.json"))
resolver = RefResolver.from_schema(spec)

def validate_resp(path_template, method, status, body):
    op = spec["paths"][path_template][method.lower()]
    resp_spec = op["responses"].get(str(status))
    assert resp_spec is not None, f"Unexpected status {status} for {method} {path_template}: {body}"
    schema = resp_spec["content"]["application/json"]["schema"]
    validate(instance=body, schema=schema, resolver=resolver)

def req(method, path, data=None, token=None, path_template=None):
    if path_template is None:
        path_template = path
    url = "http://127.0.0.1:18082" + path

        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"

    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body_bytes, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
            b = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
            validate_resp(path_template, method, resp.status, b)
            return resp.status, b
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:

    op = spec["paths"][path_template][method.lower()]
    resp_spec = op["responses"].get(str(status))
    assert resp_spec is not None, f"Unexpected status {status} for {method} {path_template}: {body}"
    schema = resp_spec["content"]["application/json"]["schema"]
    validate(instance=body, schema=schema, resolver=resolver)

    if path_template is None:
        path_template = path
    url = "http://127.0.0.1:18082" + path
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    if token:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
    body_bytes = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8") if data is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body_bytes, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:

            b = json.loads(raw) if raw else None

spec = json.load(open("/workspace/contracts/openapi.contract.json"))
resolver = RefResolver.from_schema(spec)

def validate_resp(path_template, method, status, body):
    op = spec["paths"][path_template][method.lower()]
    resp_spec = op["responses"].get(str(status))
    assert resp_spec is not None, f"Unexpected status {status} for {method} {path_template}: {body}"
    schema = resp_spec["content"]["application/json"]["schema"]
    validate(instance=body, schema=schema, resolver=resolver)

def req(method, path, data=None, token=None, path_template=None):
    if path_template is None:
        path_template = path
    url = "http://127.0.0.1:18082" + path
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    if token:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
    body_bytes = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8") if data is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body_bytes, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
            b = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
            validate_resp(path_template, method, resp.status, b)
            return resp.status, b
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raw = e.read().decode("utf-8")
        b = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
        validate_resp(path_template, method, e.code, b)
        return e.code, b

def validate_resp(path_template, method, status, body):
    op = spec["paths"][path_template][method.lower()]
    resp_spec = op["responses"].get(str(status))
    assert resp_spec is not None, f"Unexpected status {status} for {method} {path_template}: {body}"
    schema = resp_spec["content"]["application/json"]["schema"]
    validate(instance=body, schema=schema, resolver=resolver)

def req(method, path, data=None, token=None, path_template=None):
    if path_template is None:
        path_template = path
    url = "http://127.0.0.1:18082" + path
    headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
    if token:
        headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {token}"
    body_bytes = json.dumps(data).encode("utf-8") if data is not None else None
    r = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body_bytes, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r) as resp:
            raw = resp.read().decode("utf-8")
            b = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
            validate_resp(path_template, method, resp.status, b)
            return resp.status, b
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        raw = e.read().decode("utf-8")
        b = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
        validate_resp(path_template, method, e.code, b)
        return e.code, b

        "fromLocationId": cp_id,
        "toLocationId": hub_id,
        "travelMinutes": 15,
        "costUnits": 5.0,
        "cooled": True,
        "capacityUnits": 10,
        "cooledCapacityUnits": 5,
        "active": True,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, admin_token)
    assert st == 201
    conn1_id = b["data"]["connectionId"]

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-connection", {
        "fromLocationId": hub_id,
        "toLocationId": lab_id,
        "travelMinutes": 20,
        "costUnits": 6.0,
        "cooled": True,
        "capacityUnits": 10,
        "cooledCapacityUnits": 5,
        "active": True,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, admin_token)
    assert st == 201
    conn2_id = b["data"]["connectionId"]

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/set-connection-status", {
        "connectionId": conn1_id,
        "active": True,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, admin_token)
    assert st == 201

    # 10. /api/configure-laboratory-acceptance & /api/configure-capacity
    for st_name, st_id in sample_types.items():
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {
            "laboratoryId": lab_id,
            "sampleTypeId": st_id,
            "accepted": True,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }, admin_token)
        assert st == 201

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {
        "resourceType": "location",
        "resourceId": lab_id,
        "capacityUnits": 25,
        "cooledCapacityUnits": 12,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, admin_token)
    assert st == 201

    # 11. /api/create-user, /api/update-user-access, /api/read-user/{id}, /api/set-worker-availability
    users = {}
    for uname, role, loc_id, quals in [
        ("req1", "requester", None, []),
        ("col1", "collection_professional", None, ["amber", "indigo", "frost", "pulse", sample_types["Amber"]]),
        ("cour1", "delivery_partner", None, []),
        ("node1", "node_handler", hub_id, []),
        ("lab1", "laboratory_team", lab_id, []),
        ("disp1", "dispatcher", None, [])
    ]:
        payload = {
            "username": uname,
            "password": "password123",
            "roles": [role],
            "qualifications": quals,
            "active": True,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }
        if loc_id:
            payload["assignedLocationId"] = loc_id
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-user", payload, admin_token)
        assert st == 201, f"create-user {uname} failed: {st} {b}"
        uid = b["data"]["userId"]

        st, b = req("GET", f"/api/read-user/{uid}", token=admin_token, path_template="/api/read-user/{id}")
        assert st == 200

        # Login and select role
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": uname, "password": "password123"})
        assert st == 200
        tok = b["data"]["sessionToken"]
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": role, "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())}, tok)
        assert st == 201
        users[uname] = {"id": uid, "token": tok, "role": role}

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/set-worker-availability", {
        "workerId": users["col1"]["id"],
        "available": True,
        "capacityUnits": 5,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, admin_token)
    assert st == 201

    # 12. /api/check-serviceability (dry run)
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", {
        "origin": {"latitude": 12.9720, "longitude": 77.5950, "originType": "home"},
        "sampleTypeId": sample_types["Amber"],
        "requestedAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z",
        "collectionWindow": {"earliestAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z", "latestAt": "2026-10-16T10:00:00Z"},
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-10-16T13:00:00Z"
    }, users["req1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and b["data"]["serviceability"] == "serviceable", f"got {st}: {b}"

    # Verify dry run created nothing in operations state
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-operations-state", {}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["samples"]) == 0, f"dry run leaked samples: {b}"

    # 13. /api/create-collection-request
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", {
        "origin": {"latitude": 12.9720, "longitude": 77.5950, "originType": "home"},
        "sampleTypeId": sample_types["Amber"],
        "requestedAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z",
        "collectionWindow": {"earliestAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z", "latestAt": "2026-10-16T10:00:00Z"},
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-10-16T13:00:00Z",
        "containerType": "amber_vial",
        "temperatureMinC": 2.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 25.0,
        "incompatibleSampleTypes": [sample_types["Indigo"]],
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["req1"]["token"])
    assert st == 201, f"got {st}: {b}"
    sample_id = b["data"]["sampleId"]
    journey_id = b["data"]["journeyId"]

    # 14. /api/read-sample-state/{id} & /api/read-sample-lifecycle & /api/read-journey-plan
    st, b = req("GET", f"/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", token=users["req1"]["token"], path_template="/api/read-sample-state/{id}")
    assert st == 200
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample_id}, users["req1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200
    assignments = b["data"]["assignments"]
    assert len(assignments) >= 2, f"expected assignments: {assignments}"

    # 15. /api/list-role-work for col1
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["currentWork"]) == 1, f"got {st}: {b}"
    col_assign_id = b["data"]["currentWork"][0]["assignmentId"]

    # 16. /api/accept-assignment for col1, cour1, node1, lab1
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st == 201

    for ukey in ["cour1", "node1", "lab1"]:
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, users[ukey]["token"])
        assert st == 200
        for w_item in b["data"]["currentWork"]:
            if w_item["status"] == "offered":
                st2, b2 = req("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {
                    "assignmentId": w_item["assignmentId"],
                    "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
                }, users[ukey]["token"])
                assert st2 == 201

    # 17. /api/record-worker-location
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/record-worker-location", {
        "latitude": 12.9721,
        "longitude": 77.5951,
        "recordedAt": "2026-10-16T09:10:00Z",
        "sequence": 1,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st == 201

    # 18. /api/collect-and-seal-sample
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/collect-and-seal-sample", {
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "collectedAt": "2026-10-16T09:15:00Z",
        "sealed": True,
        "containerType": "amber_vial",
        "observedTemperatureC": 15.0,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st == 201 and b["data"]["currentHolderId"] == users["col1"]["id"]

    # 19. /api/record-handling-checkpoint
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/record-handling-checkpoint", {
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "containerType": "amber_vial",
        "observedTemperatureC": 16.0,
        "recordedAt": "2026-10-16T09:18:00Z",
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st == 201 and b["data"]["compliant"] is True

    # 20. Handoffs through the journey to laboratory receipt!
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    assigns = sorted(b["data"]["assignments"], key=lambda x: x["sequence"])

    role_user_map = {
        "collection": "col1",
        "transport": "cour1",
        "node": "node1",
        "laboratory": "lab1"
    }

    for idx in range(len(assigns) - 1):
        fa = assigns[idx]
        ta = assigns[idx + 1]
        sender_u = users[role_user_map[fa["kind"]]]
        receiver_u = users[role_user_map[ta["kind"]]]
        t_iso = f"2026-10-16T09:{20 + idx*10:02d}:00Z"

        # If transport leg, test update-assignment-progress
        if fa["kind"] == "transport":
            st, b = req("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {
                "assignmentId": fa["assignmentId"],
                "status": "in_progress",
                "recordedAt": t_iso,
                "latitude": 12.9750,
                "longitude": 77.5980,
                "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
            }, sender_u["token"])
            assert st == 201

        st, b = req("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {
            "sampleId": sample_id,
            "fromAssignmentId": fa["assignmentId"],
            "toAssignmentId": ta["assignmentId"],
            "initiatedAt": t_iso,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }, sender_u["token"])
        assert st == 201, f"initiate handoff {idx} failed: {st} {b}"
        handoff_id = b["data"]["handoffId"]

        st, b = req("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {
            "handoffId": handoff_id,
            "confirmationSide": "sender",
            "confirmedAt": t_iso,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }, sender_u["token"])
        assert st == 201 and b["data"]["currentHolderId"] == sender_u["id"]

        st, b = req("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {
            "handoffId": handoff_id,
            "confirmationSide": "receiver",
            "confirmedAt": t_iso,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }, receiver_u["token"])
        assert st == 201 and b["data"]["currentHolderId"] == receiver_u["id"]

    # 21. /api/confirm-laboratory-receipt
    last_assign = assigns[-1]
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {
        "assignmentId": last_assign["assignmentId"],
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "laboratoryId": lab_id,
        "receivedAt": "2026-10-16T10:30:00Z",
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["lab1"]["token"])
    assert st == 201 and b["data"]["status"] == "received", f"got {st}: {b}"

    # 22. /api/search-audit-trail
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {"sampleId": sample_id}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["records"]) > 0

    print("ALL ENDPOINTS & FULL LIFECYCLE SCHEMA VALIDATED SUCCESSFULLY!")
finally:
    proc.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    proc.wait()

type Server struct {
	db       *pgxpool.Pool
	wsMu     sync.Mutex

	upgrader websocket.Upgrader
}

func NewServer(db *pgxpool.Pool) *Server {
	return &Server{
		db:      db,
		wsConns: make(map[*websocket.Conn]string),
		upgrader: websocket.Upgrader{
			CheckOrigin: func(r *http.Request) bool { return true },
		},
	}
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}

func writeData(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, data any) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]any{"data": data})
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, code string, msg string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, map[string]string{
		"error": msg,
		"code":  code,
	})
}

func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, dst any, allowEmpty bool) ([]byte, error) {
	bodyBytes, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(bodyBytes)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 {
		if allowEmpty {
			return []byte("{}"), nil
		}
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("empty body")
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(trimmed))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := dec.Decode(dst); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := dec.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("trailing data")
	}
	return trimmed, nil
}

func parseTimeISO(s string) (time.Time, error) {
	if s == "" {
		return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("empty time")
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	if t, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, s); err == nil {
		return t.UTC(), nil
	}
	return time.Time{}, fmt.Errorf("invalid time: %s", s)
}

func formatTimeISO(t time.Time) string {
	return t.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
}

func haversineKm(c1, c2 Coordinate) float64 {
	const R = 6371.0
	lat1 := c1.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	lat2 := c2.Latitude * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLat := (c2.Latitude - c1.Latitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	dLon := (c2.Longitude - c1.Longitude) * math.Pi / 180.0
	a := math.Sin(dLat/2)*math.Sin(dLat/2) +
		math.Cos(lat1)*math.Cos(lat2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)*math.Sin(dLon/2)
	c := 2 * math.Atan2(math.Sqrt(a), math.Sqrt(1-a))
	return R * c
}

func validateCoordinate(c Coordinate) bool {
	if math.IsNaN(c.Latitude) || math.IsNaN(c.Longitude) {
		return false
	}
	return c.Latitude >= -90 && c.Latitude <= 90 && c.Longitude >= -180 && c.Longitude <= 180
}

func isValidRole(r string) bool {
	switch r {
	case "administrator", "dispatcher", "requester", "collection_professional", "delivery_partner", "node_handler", "laboratory_team":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func hasString(slice []string, val string) bool {
	for _, s := range slice {
		if s == val {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func isLocationStale(recordedAt *time.Time, refTime time.Time) bool {
	if recordedAt == nil {
		return true
	}
	if refTime.IsZero() {
		refTime = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	diff := refTime.Sub(*recordedAt)
	return diff > 15*time.Minute
}

func (s *Server) recordAudit(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID string, success bool, occurredAt time.Time, details map[string]any) {
	if occurredAt.IsZero() {
		occurredAt = time.Now().UTC()
	}
	if details == nil {
		details = map[string]any{}
	}
	if actorID == "" {
		actorID = "anonymous"
	}
	if role == "" {
		role = "none"
	}
	detailsBytes, _ := json.Marshal(details)
	_, _ = q.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO audit_logs (audit_id, actor_id, role, action, entity_type, entity_id, success, occurred_at, details)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
	`, uuid.New(), actorID, role, action, entityType, entityID, success, occurredAt, detailsBytes)
}

func (s *Server) publishEvent(ctx context.Context, q DBTx, evType, entityType, entityID string, payload map[string]any) {
	if payload == nil {
		payload = map[string]any{}
	}
	payloadBytes, _ := json.Marshal(payload)
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	var id int64
	err := q.QueryRow(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO realtime_events (type, entity_type, entity_id, payload, created_at)
		VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
		RETURNING id
	`, evType, entityType, entityID, payloadBytes, now).Scan(&id)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	ev := RealtimeEvent{
		ID:         id,
		Type:       evType,
		EntityType: entityType,
		EntityID:   entityID,
		Payload:    payload,
		CreatedAt:  formatTimeISO(now),
	}
	s.broadcastWS(ev)
}

func (s *Server) broadcastWS(ev RealtimeEvent) {
	s.wsMu.Lock()
	defer s.wsMu.Unlock()
	msg, err := json.Marshal(ev)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	for conn, sessToken := range s.wsConns {
		if !s.canSessionReceiveEvent(ctx, sessToken, ev) {
			continue
		}
		_ = conn.SetWriteDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
		if err := conn.WriteMessage(websocket.TextMessage, msg); err != nil {
			_ = conn.Close()
			delete(s.wsConns, conn)
		}
	}
}

func (s *Server) canSessionReceiveEvent(ctx context.Context, sessToken string, ev RealtimeEvent) bool {
	if sessToken == "" {
		return false
	}
	var userID uuid.UUID
	var rolesBytes []byte
	var activeRole string
	var roleSelected, active bool
	var assignedLocID *uuid.UUID
	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT u.user_id, u.roles, u.active, u.assigned_location_id, s.active_role, s.role_selected
		FROM sessions s
		JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
		WHERE s.token = $1
	`, sessToken).Scan(&userID, &rolesBytes, &active, &assignedLocID, &activeRole, &roleSelected)
	if err != nil || !active {
		return false
	}
	var roles []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rolesBytes, &roles)
	if len(roles) == 1 && !roleSelected {
		activeRole = roles[0]
		roleSelected = true
	}
	if !roleSelected || activeRole == "" || !hasString(roles, activeRole) {
		return false
	}
	if activeRole == "administrator" || activeRole == "dispatcher" {
		return true
	}

	// Extract sampleId from event if available
	sampleIDStr := ""
	if ev.EntityType == "sample" {
		sampleIDStr = ev.EntityID
	} else if v, ok := ev.Payload["sampleId"].(string); ok {
		sampleIDStr = v
	}

	if activeRole == "requester" {
		if sampleIDStr == "" && ev.EntityType == "journey" {
			if sids, ok := ev.Payload["sampleIds"].([]string); ok && len(sids) > 0 {
				sampleIDStr = sids[0]
			} else if sidsAny, ok := ev.Payload["sampleIds"].([]any); ok && len(sidsAny) > 0 {
				if s0, ok := sidsAny[0].(string); ok {
					sampleIDStr = s0
				}
			}
		}
		if sampleIDStr == "" {
			return false
		}
		sid, err := uuid.Parse(sampleIDStr)
		if err != nil {
			return false
		}
		var reqID *uuid.UUID
		if err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT requester_id FROM samples WHERE sample_id = $1`, sid).Scan(&reqID); err != nil {
			return false
		}
		return reqID != nil && *reqID == userID
	}

	// Worker roles: collection_professional, delivery_partner, node_handler, laboratory_team
	if ev.EntityType == "user" && ev.EntityID == userID.String() {
		return true
	}
	if ev.EntityType == "capacity" && assignedLocID != nil && ev.EntityID == assignedLocID.String() {
		return (activeRole == "node_handler" || activeRole == "laboratory_team")
	}
	if ev.EntityType == "assignment" {
		if wStr, ok := ev.Payload["workerId"].(string); ok && wStr == userID.String() {
			return true
		}
		if aid, err := uuid.Parse(ev.EntityID); err == nil {
			var wID, offID, nID, lID *uuid.UUID
			if err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT worker_id, offered_to_worker_id, node_id, laboratory_id FROM assignments WHERE assignment_id = $1`, aid).Scan(&wID, &offID, &nID, &lID); err == nil {
				if (wID != nil && *wID == userID) || (offID != nil && *offID == userID) {
					return true
				}
				if assignedLocID != nil && ((nID != nil && *nID == *assignedLocID) || (lID != nil && *lID == *assignedLocID)) {
					return true
				}
			}
		}
		return false
	}
	if ev.EntityType == "handoff" {
		if sStr, ok := ev.Payload["senderId"].(string); ok && sStr == userID.String() {
			return true
		}
		if rStr, ok := ev.Payload["receiverId"].(string); ok && rStr == userID.String() {
			return true
		}
		return false
	}
	if sampleIDStr != "" {
		if sid, err := uuid.Parse(sampleIDStr); err == nil {
			var holderID, targetLabID *uuid.UUID
			if err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT current_holder_id, target_laboratory_id FROM samples WHERE sample_id = $1`, sid).Scan(&holderID, &targetLabID); err == nil {
				if holderID != nil && *holderID == userID {
					return true
				}
				if activeRole == "laboratory_team" && assignedLocID != nil && targetLabID != nil && *targetLabID == *assignedLocID {
					return true
				}
			}
			var cnt int
			_ = s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignments WHERE sample_id = $1 AND (worker_id = $2 OR offered_to_worker_id = $2)`, sid, userID).Scan(&cnt)
			if cnt > 0 {
				return true
			}
		}
	}
	return false
}

func hashRequestPayload(raw []byte) string {
	var canonical any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &canonical); err == nil {
		if b, err := json.Marshal(canonical); err == nil {
			raw = b
		}
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(raw)
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}

func (s *Server) checkIdempotency(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, operation, key string, rawReq []byte) bool {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return false
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	var storedHash string
	var storedStatus int
	var storedResp []byte
	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT req_hash, status_code, response_body
		FROM idempotency_keys
		WHERE key = $1 AND operation = $2
	`, key, operation).Scan(&storedHash, &storedStatus, &storedResp)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if storedHash != reqHash {
		writeError(w, 409, "idempotency_conflict", "Idempotency key reused with different request payload")
		return true
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(storedStatus)
	_, _ = w.Write(storedResp)
	return true
}

func (s *Server) saveIdempotency(ctx context.Context, operation, key string, rawReq []byte, status int, dataPayload any) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(key) == "" {
		return
	}
	reqHash := hashRequestPayload(rawReq)
	envelope := map[string]any{"data": dataPayload}
	respBytes, _ := json.Marshal(envelope)
	_, _ = s.db.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO idempotency_keys (key, operation, actor_id, req_hash, status_code, response_body)
		VALUES ($1, $2, '', $3, $4, $5)
		ON CONFLICT (key, operation) DO NOTHING
	`, key, operation, reqHash, status, respBytes)
}

func decodeTokenCandidates(raw string) []string {
	raw = strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if raw == "" {
		return nil
	}
	candidates := []string{raw}
	encodings := []*base64.Encoding{
		base64.RawURLEncoding,
		base64.URLEncoding,
		base64.RawStdEncoding,
		base64.StdEncoding,
	}
	for _, enc := range encodings {
		if dec, err := enc.DecodeString(raw); err == nil && len(dec) > 0 {
			s := strings.TrimSpace(string(dec))
			if strings.HasPrefix(s, "bearer.") {
				s = strings.TrimPrefix(s, "bearer.")
			} else if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(s), "bearer ") {
				s = strings.TrimSpace(s[7:])
			}
			if s != "" && !hasString(candidates, s) {
				candidates = append(candidates, s)
			}
		}
	}
	return candidates
}

func (s *Server) authenticateRequest(ctx context.Context, r *http.Request) (*AuthContext, error) {
	var candidates []string
	addCandidates := func(raw string) {
		for _, c := range decodeTokenCandidates(raw) {
			if !hasString(candidates, c) {
				candidates = append(candidates, c)
			}
		}
	}

	authHeader := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Authorization"))
	if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(authHeader), "bearer ") {
		addCandidates(strings.TrimSpace(authHeader[7:]))
	}
	wsProto := r.Header.Get("Sec-WebSocket-Protocol")
	for _, part := range strings.Split(wsProto, ",") {
		p := strings.TrimSpace(part)
		if strings.HasPrefix(p, "bearer.") {
			addCandidates(strings.TrimPrefix(p, "bearer."))
		} else if strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(p), "bearer ") {
			addCandidates(strings.TrimSpace(p[7:]))
		} else if p != "" && p != "json" && p != "realtime" && p != "lab-logistics-v1" && len(p) > 12 {
			addCandidates(p)
		}
	}
	if qTok := strings.TrimSpace(r.URL.Query().Get("token")); qTok != "" {
		addCandidates(qTok)
	}
	if len(candidates) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("missing token")
	}

	var matchedToken string
	var userID uuid.UUID
	var username, fullName, activeRole string
	var roleSelected, active, available bool
	var rolesBytes, qualsBytes, certsBytes []byte
	var assignedLocID *uuid.UUID
	var capUnits int

	err := s.db.QueryRow(ctx, `
		SELECT s.token, u.user_id, u.username, u.full_name, u.roles, u.qualifications, u.certifications,
		       u.active, u.assigned_location_id, u.available, u.capacity_units,
		       s.active_role, s.role_selected
		FROM sessions s
		JOIN users u ON u.user_id = s.user_id
		WHERE s.token = ANY($1)
		LIMIT 1
	`, candidates).Scan(
		&matchedToken, &userID, &username, &fullName, &rolesBytes, &qualsBytes, &certsBytes,
		&active, &assignedLocID, &available, &capUnits,
		&activeRole, &roleSelected,
	)
	if err != nil || !active {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid session")
	}
	token := matchedToken

	var roles []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(rolesBytes, &roles)
	var quals []string
	_ = json.Unmarshal(qualsBytes, &quals)
	var certs []Certification
	_ = json.Unmarshal(certsBytes, &certs)

	if len(roles) == 1 && !roleSelected {
		activeRole = roles[0]
		roleSelected = true
	}
	if activeRole != "" && !hasString(roles, activeRole) {
		if len(roles) == 1 {
			activeRole = roles[0]
			roleSelected = true
		} else {
			activeRole = ""
			roleSelected = false
		}
	}

	return &AuthContext{
		UserID:             userID,
		Username:           username,
		FullName:           fullName,
		Roles:              roles,
		ActiveRole:         activeRole,
		RoleSelected:       roleSelected,
		Active:             active,
		AssignedLocationID: assignedLocID,
		Qualifications:     quals,
		Certifications:     certs,
		Available:          available,
		CapacityUnits:      capUnits,
		SessionToken:       token,
	}, nil
}

func (s *Server) requireRole(ctx context.Context, w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, actionName string, allowedRoles ...string) (*AuthContext, bool) {
	auth, err := s.authenticateRequest(ctx, r)
	if err != nil {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, "anonymous", "none", actionName, "auth", "unauthorized", false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "unauthorized"})
		writeError(w, 401, "unauthorized", "Authentication required")
		return nil, false
	}
	if !auth.RoleSelected || auth.ActiveRole == "" {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), "unselected", actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "role_not_selected"})
		writeError(w, 409, "role_not_selected", "Active role must be selected first")
		return nil, false
	}
	if len(allowedRoles) > 0 && !hasString(allowedRoles, auth.ActiveRole) {
		s.recordAudit(ctx, s.db, auth.UserID.String(), auth.ActiveRole, actionName, "permission", auth.UserID.String(), false, time.Now().UTC(), map[string]any{"reason": "forbidden", "requiredRoles": allowedRoles})
		writeError(w, 403, "forbidden", "Active role is not permitted to perform this action")
		return nil, false
	}
	return auth, true
}

type Server struct {
