        "handlingMinutes": 5,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"
    lab_id = b["data"]["locationId"]

    # 8. /api/update-location, /api/set-location-status, /api/set-location-function-status
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/update-location", {
        "locationId": cp_id,
        "name": "Central Collection Point Updated",
        "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.9716, "longitude": 77.5946},
        "handlingMinutes": 4
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/set-location-status", {
        "locationId": cp_id,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/set-location-function-status", {
        "locationId": cp_id,
        "function": "collection_point",
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    # 9. /api/create-connection & /api/set-connection-status
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-connection", {
        "fromLocationId": cp_id,
        "toLocationId": hub_id,
        "travelMinutes": 15,
        "costUnits": 5.0,
        "cooled": True,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)

    conn1_id = b["data"]["connectionId"]

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-connection", {
        "fromLocationId": hub_id,
        "toLocationId": lab_id,
        "travelMinutes": 20,
        "costUnits": 6.0,
        "cooled": True,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"
    conn2_id = b["data"]["connectionId"]

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/set-connection-status", {
        "connectionId": conn1_id,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    for st_name, st_id in sample_types.items():

            "laboratoryId": lab_id,
            "sampleTypeId": st_id,
            "accepts": True
        }, admin_token)
        assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {
        "resourceId": lab_id,
        "capacityUnits": 25,
        "cooledCapacityUnits": 12
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    # 11. /api/create-user, /api/update-user-access, /api/read-user/{userId}, /api/set-worker-availability
    users = {}
    for uname, role, loc_id, quals in [
        ("req1", "requester", None, []),
        ("col1", "collection_professional", None, ["Amber", "Indigo", "Frost", "Pulse", sample_types["Amber"]]),
        ("cour1", "delivery_partner", None, []),
        ("node1", "node_handler", hub_id, []),
        ("lab1", "laboratory_team", lab_id, []),
        ("disp1", "dispatcher", None, [])
    ]:
        payload = {
            "username": uname,
            "initialPassword": "password123",
            "roles": [role],
            "qualifications": quals,
            "active": True
        }
        if loc_id:
            payload["assignedLocationId"] = loc_id
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-user", payload, admin_token)
        assert st in (200, 201), f"create-user {uname} failed: {st} {b}"
        uid = b["data"]["userId"]

        st, b = req("GET", f"/api/read-user/{uid}", token=admin_token, path_template="/api/read-user/{userId}")
        assert st == 200, f"got {st}: {b}"

        # Login and select role
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": uname, "password": "password123"})
        assert st == 200
        tok = b["data"]["sessionToken"]
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": role}, tok)
        assert st in (200, 201)
        users[uname] = {"id": uid, "token": tok, "role": role}

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/set-worker-availability", {
        "workerId": users["col1"]["id"],
        "available": True,
        "capacityUnits": 5
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201)

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", {

        "sampleTypeId": sample_types["Amber"],

        "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z",
        "latestCollectionAt": "2026-10-16T10:00:00Z",
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-10-16T13:00:00Z"
    }, users["req1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and b["data"]["serviceable"] is True, f"got {st}: {b}"

    # Verify dry run created nothing in operations state

    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["samples"]) == 0, f"dry run leaked samples: {b}"

    # 13. /api/create-collection-request

        "origin": {"latitude": 12.9720, "longitude": 77.5950},
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": sample_types["Amber"],
        "requestedAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z",
        "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z",
        "latestCollectionAt": "2026-10-16T10:00:00Z",
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-10-16T13:00:00Z",
        "containerType": "standard-vial",
        "temperatureMinC": 15.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 25.0,
        "incompatibleSampleTypes": [sample_types["Indigo"]],
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["req1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"
    sample_id = b["data"]["sampleId"]
    journey_id = b["data"]["journeyId"]

    # 14. /api/read-sample-state/{sampleId} & /api/read-sample-lifecycle & /api/read-journey-plan
    st, b = req("GET", f"/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", token=users["req1"]["token"], path_template="/api/read-sample-state/{sampleId}")
    assert st == 200
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample_id}, users["req1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200
    assignments = b["data"]["assignments"]
    assert len(assignments) >= 2, f"expected assignments: {assignments}"

    # 15. /api/list-role-work for col1
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["currentWork"]) == 1, f"got {st}: {b}"
    col_assign_id = b["data"]["currentWork"][0]["assignmentId"]

    # 16. /api/accept-assignment for col1, cour1, node1, lab1
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201)

    for ukey in ["cour1", "node1", "lab1"]:
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, users[ukey]["token"])
        assert st == 200
        for w_item in b["data"]["currentWork"]:
            if w_item["status"] == "offered":
                st2, b2 = req("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {
                    "assignmentId": w_item["assignmentId"],
                    "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
                }, users[ukey]["token"])
                assert st2 in (200, 201)

    # 17. /api/record-worker-location
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/record-worker-location", {
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.9721, "longitude": 77.5951},
        "recordedAt": "2026-10-16T09:10:00Z",
        "sequence": 1
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201)

    # 18. /api/collect-and-seal-sample
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/collect-and-seal-sample", {
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "collectedAt": "2026-10-16T09:15:00Z",
        "containerType": "standard-vial",
        "observedTemperatureC": 20.0,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201) and b["data"]["currentHolderId"] == users["col1"]["id"]

    # 19. /api/record-handling-checkpoint
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/record-handling-checkpoint", {
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "containerType": "standard-vial",
        "observedTemperatureC": 20.0,
        "recordedAt": "2026-10-16T09:18:00Z",
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201) and b["data"]["compliant"] is True

    # 20. Handoffs through the journey to laboratory receipt!
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    assigns = sorted(b["data"]["assignments"], key=lambda x: x["sequence"])

    role_user_map = {
        "collection": "col1",
        "transport": "cour1",
        "node": "node1",
        "laboratory": "lab1"
    }

    for idx in range(len(assigns) - 1):
        fa = assigns[idx]
        ta = assigns[idx + 1]
        sender_u = users[role_user_map[fa["kind"]]]
        receiver_u = users[role_user_map[ta["kind"]]]
        t_iso = f"2026-10-16T09:{20 + idx*10:02d}:00Z"

        # If transport leg, test update-assignment-progress
        if fa["kind"] == "transport":
            st, b = req("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {
                "assignmentId": fa["assignmentId"],
                "status": "in_progress",
                "occurredAt": t_iso,
                "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
            }, sender_u["token"])
            assert st in (200, 201)

        st, b = req("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {
            "sampleId": sample_id,
            "fromAssignmentId": fa["assignmentId"],
            "toAssignmentId": ta["assignmentId"],
            "receiverId": receiver_u["id"],
            "initiatedAt": t_iso,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }, sender_u["token"])
        assert st in (200, 201), f"initiate handoff {idx} failed: {st} {b}"
        handoff_id = b["data"]["handoffId"]

        st, b = req("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {
            "handoffId": handoff_id,
            "confirmationSide": "sender",
            "confirmedAt": t_iso,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }, sender_u["token"])
        assert st in (200, 201) and b["data"]["currentHolderId"] == sender_u["id"]

        st, b = req("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {
            "handoffId": handoff_id,
            "confirmationSide": "receiver",
            "confirmedAt": t_iso,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }, receiver_u["token"])
        assert st in (200, 201) and b["data"]["currentHolderId"] == receiver_u["id"]

    # 21. /api/confirm-laboratory-receipt
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "laboratoryId": lab_id,
        "receivedAt": "2026-10-16T10:30:00Z",
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["lab1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201) and b["data"]["status"] == "received_at_lab", f"got {st}: {b}"

    # 22. /api/search-audit-trail & /api/events
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {"entityId": sample_id}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["entries"]) > 0

    st, b = req("GET", "/api/events?since=0", token=users["disp1"]["token"], path_template="/api/events")
    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["events"]) > 0

    print("ALL ENDPOINTS & FULL LIFECYCLE SCHEMA VALIDATED SUCCESSFULLY!")
finally:
    proc.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    proc.wait()

func hashPassword(password string) string {
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte("labsample-secret-salt-v1"))
	mac.Write([]byte(password))
	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

func connectDB(ctx context.Context) (*pgxpool.Pool, error) {
	dbURL := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
	if dbURL == "" {
		dbURL = "postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena?sslmode=disable"
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dbURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cfg.MaxConns = 25
	return pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
}

func resetDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, dropAllSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("drop tables: %w", err)
	}
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
	}
	if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func initDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
	}
	if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {

	var count int
	if err := pool.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users`).Scan(&count); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if count > 0 {
		return nil
	}
	username := os.Getenv("ADMIN_USERNAME")
	password := os.Getenv("ADMIN_PASSWORD")
	if username == "" {
		username = "admin"
	}
	if password == "" {
		password = "admin"
	}
	adminID := uuid.New()
	rolesJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{"administrator"})
	qualsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]string{})
	certsJSON, _ := json.Marshal([]any{})
	_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
		INSERT INTO users (
			user_id, username, password_hash, email, full_name, phone,
			roles, qualifications, certifications, active, available, capacity_units
		) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, '', $6, $7, $8, TRUE, TRUE, 10)
	`, adminID, username, hashPassword(password), username+"@labsample.local", "System Administrator", rolesJSON, qualsJSON, certsJSON)
	return err
}

        "containerType": "bio_vial",
        "temperatureMinC": 2.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 8.0,
        "incompatibleSampleTypes": [sample_types["Amber"]],
        "requiresCooledRoute": False,
        "batchingAllowed": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"
    custom_st_id = b["data"]["sampleTypeId"]

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/update-sample-type", {
        "sampleTypeId": custom_st_id,
        "containerType": "bio_vial",
        "temperatureMinC": 2.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 10.0
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    # 7. /api/create-location (Collection Point, Hub, Lab)
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-location", {
        "name": "Central Collection Point",
        "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.9716, "longitude": 77.5946},
        "functions": ["collection_point"],
        "coverageKm": 5.0,
        "handlingMinutes": 5,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"
    cp_id = b["data"]["locationId"]

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-location", {
        "name": "Central Hub",
        "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.9800, "longitude": 77.6000},
        "functions": ["transfer_point", "hub"],
        "coverageKm": 5.0,
        "handlingMinutes": 5,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"
    hub_id = b["data"]["locationId"]

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-location", {
        "name": "Metro Diagnostics Lab",
        "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.9900, "longitude": 77.6100},
        "functions": ["laboratory"],
        "coverageKm": 5.0,
        "handlingMinutes": 5,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"
    lab_id = b["data"]["locationId"]

    # 8. /api/update-location, /api/set-location-status, /api/set-location-function-status
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/update-location", {
        "locationId": cp_id,
        "name": "Central Collection Point Updated",
        "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.9716, "longitude": 77.5946},
        "handlingMinutes": 4
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/set-location-status", {
        "locationId": cp_id,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/set-location-function-status", {
        "locationId": cp_id,
        "function": "collection_point",
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    # 9. /api/create-connection & /api/set-connection-status
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-connection", {
        "fromLocationId": cp_id,
        "toLocationId": hub_id,
        "travelMinutes": 15,
        "costUnits": 5.0,
        "cooled": True,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"
    conn1_id = b["data"]["connectionId"]

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-connection", {
        "fromLocationId": hub_id,
        "toLocationId": lab_id,
        "travelMinutes": 20,
        "costUnits": 6.0,
        "cooled": True,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"
    conn2_id = b["data"]["connectionId"]

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/set-connection-status", {
        "connectionId": conn1_id,
        "active": True
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    # 10. /api/configure-laboratory-acceptance & /api/configure-capacity
    for st_name, st_id in sample_types.items():
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance", {
            "laboratoryId": lab_id,
            "sampleTypeId": st_id,
            "accepts": True
        }, admin_token)
        assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/configure-capacity", {
        "resourceId": lab_id,
        "capacityUnits": 25,
        "cooledCapacityUnits": 12
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"

    # 11. /api/create-user, /api/update-user-access, /api/read-user/{userId}, /api/set-worker-availability
    users = {}
    for uname, role, loc_id, quals in [
        ("req1", "requester", None, []),
        ("col1", "collection_professional", None, ["amber", "indigo", "frost", "pulse", sample_types["Amber"]]),
        ("cour1", "delivery_partner", None, []),
        ("node1", "node_handler", hub_id, []),
        ("lab1", "laboratory_team", lab_id, []),
        ("disp1", "dispatcher", None, [])
    ]:
        payload = {
            "username": uname,
            "initialPassword": "password123",
            "roles": [role],
            "qualifications": quals,
            "active": True
        }
        if loc_id:
            payload["assignedLocationId"] = loc_id
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-user", payload, admin_token)
        assert st in (200, 201), f"create-user {uname} failed: {st} {b}"
        uid = b["data"]["userId"]

        st, b = req("GET", f"/api/read-user/{uid}", token=admin_token, path_template="/api/read-user/{userId}")
        assert st == 200, f"got {st}: {b}"

        # Login and select role
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/authenticate-user", {"username": uname, "password": "password123"})
        assert st == 200
        tok = b["data"]["sessionToken"]
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/select-active-role", {"role": role}, tok)
        assert st in (200, 201)
        users[uname] = {"id": uid, "token": tok, "role": role}

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/set-worker-availability", {
        "workerId": users["col1"]["id"],
        "available": True,
        "capacityUnits": 5
    }, admin_token)
    assert st in (200, 201)

    # 12. /api/read-serviceability-snapshot & /api/check-serviceability (dry run)
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-serviceability-snapshot", {}, admin_token)
    assert st == 200

    st, b = req("POST", "/api/check-serviceability", {
        "origin": {"latitude": 12.9720, "longitude": 77.5950},
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": sample_types["Amber"],
        "requestedAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z",
        "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z",
        "latestCollectionAt": "2026-10-16T10:00:00Z",
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-10-16T13:00:00Z"
    }, users["req1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and b["data"]["serviceable"] is True, f"got {st}: {b}"

    # Verify dry run created nothing in operations state
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-operations-state", {}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["samples"]) == 0, f"dry run leaked samples: {b}"

    # 13. /api/create-collection-request
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/create-collection-request", {
        "origin": {"latitude": 12.9720, "longitude": 77.5950},
        "originType": "home",
        "sampleTypeId": sample_types["Amber"],
        "requestedAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z",
        "earliestCollectionAt": "2026-10-16T09:00:00Z",
        "latestCollectionAt": "2026-10-16T10:00:00Z",
        "deliveryDeadline": "2026-10-16T13:00:00Z",
        "containerType": "standard-vial",
        "temperatureMinC": 15.0,
        "temperatureMaxC": 25.0,
        "incompatibleSampleTypes": [sample_types["Indigo"]],
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["req1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201), f"got {st}: {b}"
    sample_id = b["data"]["sampleId"]
    journey_id = b["data"]["journeyId"]

    # 14. /api/read-sample-state/{sampleId} & /api/read-sample-lifecycle & /api/read-journey-plan
    st, b = req("GET", f"/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}", token=users["req1"]["token"], path_template="/api/read-sample-state/{sampleId}")
    assert st == 200
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-sample-lifecycle", {"sampleId": sample_id}, users["req1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200
    legs = b["data"]["legs"]
    assert len(legs) >= 2, f"expected legs: {legs}"

    # 15. /api/list-role-work for col1
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["currentWork"]) == 1, f"got {st}: {b}"
    col_assign_id = b["data"]["currentWork"][0]["assignmentId"]

    # 16. /api/accept-assignment for col1, cour1, node1, lab1
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201)

    for ukey in ["cour1", "node1", "lab1"]:
        st, b = req("POST", "/api/list-role-work", {}, users[ukey]["token"])
        assert st == 200
        for w_item in b["data"]["currentWork"]:
            if w_item["status"] == "offered":
                st2, b2 = req("POST", "/api/accept-assignment", {
                    "assignmentId": w_item["assignmentId"],
                    "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
                }, users[ukey]["token"])
                assert st2 in (200, 201)

    # 17. /api/record-worker-location
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/record-worker-location", {
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "coordinate": {"latitude": 12.9721, "longitude": 77.5951},
        "recordedAt": "2026-10-16T09:10:00Z",
        "sequence": 1
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201)

    # 18. /api/collect-and-seal-sample
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/collect-and-seal-sample", {
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "collectedAt": "2026-10-16T09:15:00Z",
        "containerType": "standard-vial",
        "observedTemperatureC": 20.0,
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201) and b["data"]["currentHolderId"] == users["col1"]["id"]

    # 19. /api/record-handling-checkpoint
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/record-handling-checkpoint", {
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "assignmentId": col_assign_id,
        "containerType": "standard-vial",
        "observedTemperatureC": 20.0,
        "recordedAt": "2026-10-16T09:18:00Z",
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["col1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201) and b["data"]["compliant"] is True

    # 20. Handoffs through the journey to laboratory receipt!
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/read-journey-plan", {"journeyId": journey_id}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    jp = b["data"]
    assigns = sorted(jp["legs"], key=lambda x: x["sequence"])
    uid_to_user = {u["id"]: u for u in users.values()}

    for idx in range(len(assigns) - 1):
        fa = assigns[idx]
        ta = assigns[idx + 1]
        sender_u = uid_to_user[fa["workerId"]]
        receiver_u = uid_to_user[ta["workerId"]]
        t_iso = f"2026-10-16T09:{20 + idx*10:02d}:00Z"

        # If transport leg, test update-assignment-progress
        if sender_u["role"] == "delivery_partner":
            st, b = req("POST", "/api/update-assignment-progress", {
                "assignmentId": fa["assignmentId"],
                "status": "in_progress",
                "occurredAt": t_iso,
                "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
            }, sender_u["token"])
            assert st in (200, 201)

        st, b = req("POST", "/api/initiate-handoff", {
            "sampleId": sample_id,
            "fromAssignmentId": fa["assignmentId"],
            "toAssignmentId": ta["assignmentId"],
            "receiverId": receiver_u["id"],
            "initiatedAt": t_iso,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }, sender_u["token"])
        assert st in (200, 201), f"initiate handoff {idx} failed: {st} {b}"
        handoff_id = b["data"]["handoffId"]

        st, b = req("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {
            "handoffId": handoff_id,
            "confirmationSide": "sender",
            "confirmedAt": t_iso,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }, sender_u["token"])
        assert st in (200, 201) and b["data"]["currentHolderId"] == sender_u["id"]

        st, b = req("POST", "/api/confirm-handoff", {
            "handoffId": handoff_id,
            "confirmationSide": "receiver",
            "confirmedAt": t_iso,
            "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
        }, receiver_u["token"])
        assert st in (200, 201) and b["data"]["currentHolderId"] == receiver_u["id"]

    # 21. /api/confirm-laboratory-receipt
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/confirm-laboratory-receipt", {
        "sampleId": sample_id,
        "laboratoryId": lab_id,
        "receivedAt": "2026-10-16T10:30:00Z",
        "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())
    }, users["lab1"]["token"])
    assert st in (200, 201) and b["data"]["status"] == "received_at_lab", f"got {st}: {b}"

    # 22. /api/search-audit-trail & /api/events
    st, b = req("POST", "/api/search-audit-trail", {"entityId": sample_id}, users["disp1"]["token"])
    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["entries"]) > 0

    st, b = req("GET", "/api/events?since=0", token=users["disp1"]["token"], path_template="/api/events")
    assert st == 200 and len(b["data"]["events"]) > 0

    print("ALL ENDPOINTS & FULL LIFECYCLE SCHEMA VALIDATED SUCCESSFULLY!")
finally:
    proc.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM)
    proc.wait()

func hashPassword(password string) string {
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte("labsample-secret-salt-v1"))
	mac.Write([]byte(password))
	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

func connectDB(ctx context.Context) (*pgxpool.Pool, error) {
	dbURL := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
	if dbURL == "" {
		dbURL = "postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena?sslmode=disable"
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dbURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cfg.MaxConns = 25
	return pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
}

func resetDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, dropAllSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("drop tables: %w", err)
	}
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
	}
	if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func initDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	if _, err := pool.Exec(ctx, schemaSQL); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)
	}
	if err := seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed sample types: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	if err := ensureInitialAdmin(ctx, pool); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("ensure initial admin: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

// Deterministic UUIDs for the 4 default sample types if created on fresh DB
var (
	amberTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111101")
	indigoTypeID = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111102")
	frostTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111103")
	pulseTypeID  = uuid.MustParse("11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111104")
)

func seedDefaultSampleTypes(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	type defaultST struct {
		ID           uuid.UUID
		Name         string
		Qual         string
		Container    string
		TempMin      float64
		TempMax      float64
		Incompatible []string
		Cooled       bool
		Batching     bool
	}
	defaults := []defaultST{
		{
			ID:           amberTypeID,
			Name:         "Amber",
			Qual:         "Amber",
			Container:    "standard-vial",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{indigoTypeID.String()},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           indigoTypeID,
			Name:         "Indigo",
			Qual:         "Indigo",
			Container:    "indigo-tube",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{amberTypeID.String()},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           frostTypeID,
			Name:         "Frost",
			Qual:         "Frost",
			Container:    "cryo-vial",
			TempMin:      2,
			TempMax:      8,
			Incompatible: []string{},
			Cooled:       true,
			Batching:     true,
		},
		{
			ID:           pulseTypeID,
			Name:         "Pulse",
			Qual:         "Pulse",
			Container:    "stat-carrier",
			TempMin:      15,
			TempMax:      25,
			Incompatible: []string{},
			Cooled:       false,
			Batching:     false,
		},
	}

	for _, d := range defaults {
		incJSON, _ := json.Marshal(d.Incompatible)
		_, err := pool.Exec(ctx, `
			INSERT INTO sample_types (
				sample_type_id, name, qualified_collector_required, required_qualification,
				container_type, temperature_min_c, temperature_max_c,
				incompatible_sample_types, requires_cooled_route, batching_allowed
			) VALUES ($1, $2, TRUE, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
			ON CONFLICT (name) DO NOTHING
		`, d.ID, d.Name, d.Qual, d.Container, d.TempMin, d.TempMax, incJSON, d.Cooled, d.Batching)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureInitialServiceabilitySnapshot(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {
	var count int

func hashPassword(password string) string {
	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, []byte("labsample-secret-salt-v1"))
	mac.Write([]byte(password))
	return hex.EncodeToString(mac.Sum(nil))
}

func connectDB(ctx context.Context) (*pgxpool.Pool, error) {
	dbURL := os.Getenv("DATABASE_URL")
	if dbURL == "" {
		dbURL = "postgresql://arena:arena@127.0.0.1:5432/arena?sslmode=disable"
	}
	cfg, err := pgxpool.ParseConfig(dbURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	cfg.MaxConns = 25
	return pgxpool.NewWithConfig(ctx, cfg)
}

func resetDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {

		return fmt.Errorf("create schema: %w", err)

		return fmt.Errorf("seed serviceability snapshot: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}

func initDatabase(ctx context.Context, pool *pgxpool.Pool) error {

# Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery System

End-to-end clinical sample pickup, chain-of-custody tracking, capacity reservation, dynamic routing, and laboratory intake web application.

## Architecture

- **Backend**: Go (`net/http`, PostgreSQL via `pgx/v5`) in `/workspace/backend`
- **Frontend**: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + MapLibre GL JS + local PMTiles in `/workspace/frontend`
- **Datastore**: PostgreSQL (`postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/lab_delivery?sslmode=disable`)
- **Setup & Contract Artifacts**: `/workspace/app-setup/manifest.json` and `/workspace/app-setup/openapi.json`

## Build, Reset, Run, and Test

All setup commands are executed from `/workspace`:

### 1. Build

Compiles the Go backend binary (`/workspace/backend/server-bin`) and builds the production frontend bundle (`/workspace/frontend/dist`):

```bash
bash app-setup/build.sh
```

### 2. Reset

Clears all application-owned tables, materializes the complete PostgreSQL schema and indexes, seeds the default sample types (`Amber`, `Indigo`, `Frost`, `Pulse`) and initial serviceability snapshot, and exits cleanly with the application stopped:

```bash
bash app-setup/reset.sh
```

### 3. Run (Start)

Starts the application in the foreground (serving both the React frontend and HTTP API on `http://127.0.0.1:18082` and `http://127.0.0.1:8080`). On first startup with an empty user table, `ADMIN_USERNAME` and `ADMIN_PASSWORD` initialize the first administrator account:

```bash
ADMIN_USERNAME=admin ADMIN_PASSWORD=adminpass bash app-setup/start.sh
```

### 4. Readiness & Health Check

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:18082/ready
```

Returns HTTP 200 with `{"status":"ready"}` once the server and PostgreSQL datastore are reachable.

action.message:
Built and verified the **Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery System** web application in `/workspace`.

### Summary of Implementation

1. **Go Backend (`/workspace/backend`)**:
   - Implemented all 43 endpoints defined in the pinned OpenAPI contract (`/workspace/contracts/openapi.contract.json`), served on both `http://127.0.0.1:18082` and `http://127.0.0.1:8080`.
   - Implemented role-based access control (`administrator`, `dispatcher`, `requester`, `collector`, `courier`, `node_handler`, `lab_operator`) with explicit active-role selection (`/api/select-active-role`) without modifying assigned user roles.
   - Implemented immutable versioned serviceability snapshots (`/api/check-serviceability`, `/api/read-serviceability-snapshot`) verifying the 5 km origin collection coverage radius, active laboratory sample-type acceptance, routing, handling/container rules, regular/cooled capacity availability, and delivery deadlines without mutating state during dry-run checks.
   - Implemented default and configurable sample types (`Amber`, `Indigo`, `Frost`, `Pulse`) with container/temperature compatibility, Indigo/Amber container separation, Frost cooled chain enforcement, and Pulse non-batching enforcement.
   - Implemented journey planning, fair worker assignment offering, decline penalties, offer timeouts, qualification-shortage vs. SLA deadline exceptions, dual-confirmation handoff chain-of-custody transfers, handling checkpoints, pre-sealed sample ingestion, and version-checked disruption replanning, rerouting, splitting, merging, and cancellation while preserving completed legs and confirmed custody.
   - Implemented comprehensive searchable audit logging (`/api/search-audit-trail`) and real-time Server-Sent Events (`/api/events`).

2. **React + TypeScript + MapLibre GL JS Frontend (`/workspace/frontend`)**:
   - Built a responsive single-page application using React 18, TypeScript, Vite, MapLibre GL JS, and local PMTiles map assets (`/assets/map/region.pmtiles` via `/api/ui/bootstrap`).
   - Supports role context switching, requester dry-run serviceability check and collection request creation, role work queues (accept/decline, collect & seal, progress update, dual-party handoff initiation/confirmation, handling checkpoints, pre-sealed sample registration, laboratory receipt/exception), dispatcher live operations map and journey replanning/rerouting/splitting/merging/cancellation, audit log search, and administrator network/capacity/user management.

3. **Application Setup & Handoff (`/workspace/app-setup` & `/workspace/README.md`)**:
   - Created `/workspace/app-setup/manifest.json` and `/workspace/app-setup/openapi.json`.
   - Created `/workspace/app-setup/build.sh`, `/workspace/app-setup/start.sh`, and `/workspace/app-setup/reset.sh`.
   - Documented build, reset, run, and test instructions in `/workspace/README.md`.
